Das Tagesgeschehen mit den aktuellsten und brisantesten Themen aus der Schweiz wird vorgestellt. In Reportagen, Porträts und Live-Gesprächen werden die Hintergründe von Schlagzeilen sowie das Geschehen aus dem In- und Ausland erläutert.

In diesem Best-of von "Der reale Irrsinn" begeben wir uns auf eine automobile Rundreise quer durch Deutschland und zeigen elf Filme, die Realsatiren eingehend darstellen und die sowohl zum Schmunzeln als auch Haareraufen anregen.

Stermann und Grissemann schlüpfen in ihre bekannten Rollen und zeigen Sketche und Außenreportagen. Neben den Ermittlern der Soko Donau und den Fernsehköchen Andi und Alex parodieren sie Personen wie Norbert Hofer, Herbert Kickl und Wolfgang Fellner.

Peter Klien rückt den Mächtigen dieses Landes mit unnachahmlichem Charme und unerwarteten Fragen zu Leibe. Weitere Fixpunkte in jeder Ausgabe sind satirisch-bissige Betrachtungen des Wochengeschehens und hochkarätige Gäste aus der Kabarettszene.

Rabenschwarzer Humor, blitzschnelle Wortattacken und gewollt provokante Bosheiten sind der Qualitätsstempel beim Quotenhit Kabarett aus Franken, wenn Markus Barth aufmischt. Diesmal mit dabei: * Luise Kinseher * Lena Loster * Jonas Greiner …

Kein Sommer ohne die Highlights aus dem schlachthof - in das Beste präsentieren Michael Altinger und Christian Springer die stärksten Solo-Auftritte, lustigsten Gespräche und Lieblingsmomente mit ihren hochkarätigen Gästen der letzten schlachthof-Folgen mit Maxi Schafroth, Luise Kinseher, Frank Lüdecke und Eva Karl Faltermeier.

Stimpel will das Beste für die Klasse - nur geht seine Vorstellung vom Besten meistens an den realen Gegebenheiten vorbei. Endlich sicher verbeamtet hat Frank Stimpel jedenfalls ein neues Ziel: Mittlere Reife für alle seine Schülerinnen und Schüler.

Der Lehrer Stimpel träumt davon, dass alle seine Schüler die mittlere Reife bestehen. Mithilfe seines alten Freundes Rolf will er die Klasse motivieren, das Abi zu machen. Er ahnt nicht, dass der Banker gerade in der Krise seines Lebens steckt.

Stimpel verdächtigt Kira, seine Kopfhörer gestohlen zu haben. Um ihr eine Lektion zu erteilen, klaut er sie zurück. In der WG geraten Lisa-Britt und Yunus aneinander. Dass es Ramadan ist und Yunus nicht fluchen darf, macht die Sache nicht einfacher.

Ausgerechnet Lehrer Stimpel will seine Klasse aufklären. Dabei merkt er, dass er selbst mehr über Sex lernen muss als die Schüler und Schülerinnen. Währenddessen will Osman mit seinem ersten Rapvideo den Durchbruch schaffen.

Holger Packebusch, der Besitzer des ortsansässigen FKK-Campingplatzes, scheint verwirrt zu sein. Als er am nächsten Morgen in Kollkamps Kanzlei auftaucht und stockend von seiner Demenz-Diagnose berichtet, übernimmt Ella seinen Fall. Packebusch wurde aufgrund seines unbekleideten Spaziergangs durchs Dorf beim Gericht angeschwärzt. Wenn sich das Gericht der Sache annimmt, besteht die Gefahr, dass er einen Betreuer vor die Nase gesetzt bekommt.

Ungewöhnliche Kundschaft hat Ella, denn sie soll zwei pubertierende Schwestern gegen ihre Eltern vertreten. Die beiden Jugendlichen fühlen sich nicht genug geliebt und wollen von zu Hause ausziehen. Die Mädchen ziehen in Christinas Baumhaus ein, Ravioli aus der Dose inklusive. Christina kennt die Eltern, Besitzer einer Fischbrötchenbude am Hafen, und versucht, zu vermitteln. Dieser Versucht bleibt allerdings leider erfolglos.

Ein lang getrenntes Ehepaar wird schlagartig wieder vereint, als die gemeinsame Tochter überraschend in Untersuchungshaft gerät. Um das rätselhafte Handeln des entfremdeten Kindes zu begreifen, begeben sich die Eltern auf eine Spurensuche im Umfeld der Festgenommenen. Dabei werden sie nicht nur mit unvermuteten Facetten ihres Kindes konfrontiert, sondern müssen sich auch mit unverarbeiteten Verletzungen, verdrängten Gefühlen und dem Scheitern der einstigen Gemeinschaft auseinandersetzen.

Der Journalist Ernst Michel muss bei den Nürnberger Prozessen im Jahr 1945 über die Täter berichten, die seine Familie ermordet haben. Auch Seweryna Szmaglewska, eine der wenigen Zeuginnen, durchlebt ihr Trauma im Gerichtssaal erneut.

Als Lauras Schwester Ana heiratet, reist Laura von Buenos Aires in ihr spanisches Heimatdorf. Dort hat ihre Jugendliebe Paco, dem sie ihr Familienerbe verkauft hat, ein Weingut gegründet. Lauras Vater Antonio gefällt das gar nicht. Dieser war einst ein erfolgreicher Geschäftsmann, hat jedoch durch seine Spielsucht sein gesamtes Vermögen verspielt. Dann wird plötzlich Lauras Tochter Irene entführt und es treten einige Familiengeheimnisse ans Licht.

pr.d: Mit atemberaubenden Bildern, grafischen Gestaltungsmitteln und einer packenden Erzählweise erkundet der Dokumentarfilm Irlands Küsten. Er führt zur herben Schönheit dieser ursprünglichen Klippenlandschaft, die Heimat einer reichen Artenvielfalt ist.

Colin Stafford-Johnson beginnt seine Reise mit der Erkundung der antiken Ruinen und der Tierwelt der Skellig Rocks, sturmumtosten Meereszacken vor der südwestlichen Ecke Irlands, auf deren Gipfel frühchristliche Mönche ein Kloster errichteten.

Colin setzt seine Reise entlang der malerischen Atlantik-Küste Irlands fort und erreicht seine Heimat, den Clew Bay. Das nächste Ziel seiner Reise ist Donegal, wo er hofft, einen guten Ort zum Beobachten von Steinadlern zu finden.

Channel 4's flagship news programme. With sport and weather.

pr.t: Ottoman Empire by Train with Alice Roberts
pr.d: Alice takes a train to the westernmost point of the Ottoman Empire, to Budapest, where she learns how close the Ottomans came to conquering all of Europe, and how it all ended. In Timişoara, Alice forensically pursues Ottoman remnants.
In Austria, Griff hears a mighty wind howling in a cave called the Mouth of Hell. Later on, he becomes a leader of sheep, dangles from a mountain and visits Mozart's birthplace.
A trusted family friend picks up Jan after school to go horseback riding, but as nightfall looms and they're still not home, what seemed like a casual afternoon slowly turns nightmarish.
The search for Jan escalates as the Brobergs call in the FBI. Jan is tasked with a disturbing life-or-death responsibility.
In 1991 while spending the Christmas holiday with the royal family at Sandringham House, Princess Diana decides to leave then-Prince Charles.

Adam Hills, Josh Widdicombe and Alex Brooker round up and examine the week's leading and most entertaining news stories via their acerbic wit, discussions and sketches. And each week, guests join them to dissect the week's events and talking points.
Sarah Millican returns to the stage with her show covering topics such as road rage, IBS, her favourite word and how she lets her husband know that "tonight's the night".
An insecure man competes for the affection of his stepchildren when their freewheeling father breezes back into town.

pr.t: Gordon Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
pr.d: In this episode, Gordon Ramsay travels to Wichita, Kansas in an attempt to save Fetch Bistro, the first dog-friendly restaurant in the state.

Notty's love for clothes has taken over every room in her house, and she now needs funds to house them all. Can expert Katie help? And will DJ PEP part with his much-loved ⚽ [EPL] Manchester United ephemera?
The competition is in Hull and first to host is 29-year-old welfare team leader Jennie. Jennie is honouring Hull's fishing history with her under-the-sea theme and hopes to win the prize catch.

It's the second night of this new competition in Hull, and the turn of 28-year-old wrestling promoter and novice cook, James to host. James is hoping to get his hands on the prize with a Mexican themed night that includes staging a full-blown wrestling match as his evening's entertainment.

This week's competition is in Hull and third to host is 47-year-old wedding stationery entrepreneur, Katrena. Vegetarian Katrena loves nothing more than a bit of glitz and glamour, and she's hoping to wow her guests with a showy cruise ship themed night to bag the thousand pound prize.

In Hull and fourth to host is 41-year-old super-confident mum of three, Natalie. Unimpressed by the food so far, Natalie reckons good quality produce can easily bag her the thousand pound prize. But can she win her guests over?

It's the fifth and final night of the week's competition in Hull and retirement community manager George is hoping his menu of simple tasty favourites will win him the prize. Having heavily criticised the food on the past four nights, expectations about his menu are running high.

Presenters Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer mix a cookery show with a chat show, and the result is `Sunday Brunch.' Each installment finds Simon and Tim cooking in the kitchen, accompanied by that week's celebrity guests. Other segments include interviews and highlights from television and film, an expert who assists with drink tasting, a round-up of what is trendy, and the ever-popular `Sunday Brunch Playlist,' which consists of music videos chosen by the presenters and their guests. Guests have included Stacey Solomon, Lisa Faulkner, Tara Reid, Rufus Wainwright and Marina Diamandis.
Evan is moving to Tokyo, so Rebecca drives him to the airport. However, after she finally confesses her feelings for him, he asks her to pick up the woman who will be going with him.

Greg Stone, the new owner of Cheers, pays a visit to the bar. The ambitious Rebecca pulls out all the stops to make a good impression. However, she is shocked when Stone fires Rebecca and promotes Sam to manager.

Sam swears to three months of celibacy to avoid being named the father of a former lover's baby. Carla warns Sam that God will curse him for breaking the vow. After two weeks of celibacy, Sam asks Father Barry for advice.

Relieved that Greg Stone has been fired, Rebecca is scheduled to meet her new executive vice-president in his office. However, not recognising him in a lift, mainly due to his youth and shortness, she rejects his advances.
Ray is upset when Debra says he is just like his cousin Gerard, and he thinks it would be a good idea to turn to his family for reassurance.
Debra spends a whole day cooking with Marie in an effort to get along with her mother-in-law, and Ray reluctantly agrees to take Robert and Frank to a car show.
Ray worries that he has passed on stupid genes to Michael because his son may be held back a year at school, just like Ray was.
Niles and Frasier attempt to restore lustre to the tarnished career of a favourite Shakespearean actor.
Frasier exists in two Valentine's Day universes, one with a beautiful waitress (Charlotte Ross) and the other alone.
Bart uses a miniature camera to spy on a bachelor party Homer is attending where there is an exotic belly dancer.
Principal Skinner persuades Homer and Marge to place their son on a student exchange programme. Meanwhile, an Albanian child comes to Springfield intent on a spot of industrial espionage.
Antonelli aims to end his record-breaking year in style, but Verstappen and Hamilton will look to frustrate him. Who'll take pole on the neon-soaked Las Vegas Strip?
Springfield Elementary hands out Academic Alerts to students who are in danger of failing, and Lisa becomes a student in danger of failing when she gets an Academic Alert for gym class.

After retrieving a piece of candy stuck to a college co-ed's pants, Homer becomes public enemy number one when the co-ed accuses Homer of touching her butt and the media makes Homer out to be a pervert.

Are super-sized sausages the key to 'Four in a Bed' glory? Lee and Jenni hope so at The Greyhound Inn in the Peak District, where they take their guests to a wildlife park and then wow them with those bountiful bangers at breakfast.
The B&Bers are in the Ribble Valley for the week's second visit, at Jack's Little Middop Farm. Jack's self-catering camping pods in the middle of a field immerse his guests in the heart of nature.

Phil and Gil host the week's third visit at Old Hall Country Breaks in Norfolk. The attention-to-detail at their self-catering accommodation gets the seal of approval from everyone, and Phil and Gil keep them sweet with a chocolatier experience.

Keighley and Justin host the week's final visit at The Half Moon Inn in Norfolk. Experienced chef Justin has piled the pressure on himself throughout the week with some big claims about his culinary chops and egg-cooking skills.
Toilet troubles, tossing and turning, and tears galore. It is a rip-roaring payment day on 'Four in a Bed'. Who has won the week?

Phil and Gil host the week's third visit at Old Hall Country Breaks in Norfolk. The attention-to-detail at their self-catering accommodation gets the seal of approval from everyone, and Phil and Gil keep them sweet with a chocolatier experience.

It's the semi-final and time for the bakers to showcase their patisserie prowess. Their precision, patience and pastry skills are pushed to the limit as they strive to prove they have what it takes to make it through to the final.

It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

The guys convert a rare Land Rover Defender from right-hand drive to left. Furthermore, in an attempt to get money for the shop, Heavy D parts out a military plane de-icer.

Parker buys a new plant to mine the promising Road Cut. Tony's crew runs bedrock to keep gold flowing. Greg and Buzz decode mysterious black pay dirt.

A family of eight sets out to build an underground home in the rolling foothills of Idaho, but Mother Nature has other plans for them; before they even pour concrete, they face a decision that will make or break their build.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Ladybug und Cat Noir treffen eine alte Bekannte. Su Han, die himmlische Hüterin des Wundersamen, taucht auf. Ladybug ist deswegen gezwungen, zu beweisen, dass sie von Meister Fu den Auftrag bekommen hat, die Wunderkiste zu bewachen.

Cap und Capper besuchen einen Jahrmarkt, um sich die Attraktionen anzusehen. Dabei bekommen sie mit, dass die beste Sängerin des Hundestreunerchors nach einem Streit mit dem Leiter Cash den Chor verlässt. Capper soll Dixies Platz einnehmen und vergisst seinen besten Freund Cap. Dixie erfährt, dass Capper kein Streuner ist, und schmiedet mit Caps Hilfe ein Komplott, um Capper aus dem Chor zu drängen.

Andy benutzt zu viel Parfüm und erweckt versehentlich Spong, einen stinkenden Geist. Mikroo muss aufgehalten werden. Dieser hat nämlich die Macht, alles, was er beängstigend findet, dramatisch zu schrumpfen, einschließlich der Ghostforce.

Als Liv mit Mike und Andy bei einer Talentshow auftreten soll, bekommt sie Lampenfieber und rennt weg. Professor Pascal lässt seine Klasse einige lebende Spinnen studieren. Mike ist entsetzt, denn er hat Arachnophobie. Doch auch Arakgum wird erweckt.

Viele New Yorker werden süchtig nach einem neuen Handyspiel. Auch Mike, der in der Rangliste nach oben klettert, ist davon betroffen, denn beim Spiel ZipZap springt ein elektronischer Geist von Bildschirm zu Bildschirm und friert alle ein.

Benedikt hat ja schon so einige unglaubliche Herausforderungen von Zuschauern gemeistert, aber diese scheint schlichtweg unmöglich zu sein: Diesmal soll er sich unsichtbar machen. Benedikt ist ratlos, denn solche Tricks kennt er nur von Zauberern.

Benedikt hat bekanntlich vor kaum etwas Angst, doch eine Sache bringt ihn zum Zittern: Tanzen. Nun muss er über sich hinaus wachsen und innerhalb von sechs Stunden drei verschiedene Tänze meistern oder sich der Strafaufgabe stellen.
Jojo und Patricia suchen im neuen Tierrätsel ein Lebewesen, das eine riesige Klappe hat.

Jojo ist sich sicher, dass er weiß, welches Tier gesucht wird. Was er jedoch nicht weiß: Er wird bei seiner Suche von Patricia verfolgt. Sie will beweisen, dass sie sich richtig gut verstecken kann. Ob Jojo auffällt, dass er beobachtet wird?

pr.d: Nachdem ein mysteriöses Monster das Dach von Sheriff Blubs Auto abgerissen hat, machen sich Dipper und Soos auf die Suche nach dem Ungeheuer, um es zu fotografieren. Derweil überträgt Mabel Gronkel Stan für einen Augenblick die Verantwortung für Schwabbel, doch Stan passt nicht auf und das Schwein wird von einem Pterodactylus geschnappt und verschleppt. Mabel setzt alles daran, um Schwabbel nach Hause zu holen, doch alleine kann sie es nicht schaffen.

Gideon beschwört den bösen Geist Bill Cipher herauf, der ihm helfen soll, Gronkel Stans Safe zu öffnen und so an die Besitzurkunde des Mystery Shack zu gelangen. Die Zahlenkombination zum Öffnen des Safes befindet sich nur in Stans Kopf und so macht sich Bill Cipher auf in Stans Psyche - dicht gefolgt von Dipper, Mabel und Soos. In Stans Gedankenwelt findet Dipper lang ersehnte Antworten, während Mabel und Soos mit aller Kraft versuchen zu verhindern, dass der Code in Gideons Hände fällt.

Nachdem Gideon Stan die Besitzurkunde für den Mystery Shack abgeluchst hat, plant er, die Hütte abzureißen und "Gideon-Land" zu bauen. Doch damit nicht genug, verfolgt er noch weitaus dunklere Ziele! Mabel und Dipper müssen ihn aufhalten.
Gramma erzählt Cricket und Tilly, dass auf ihrem Grundstück ein Schatz vergraben ist.

Dad tut so als wäre er von gestern. Er lässt sich die Welt von Bingo und Bluey neu erklären.

Bluey heckt einen Plan aus, als Papa sich darüber beschwert, dass Bluey und Bingo anders und komplett unterschiedlich sind. Die Hündin lässt es sich daher nicht nehmen, die beiden ähnlicher zu machen und konzipiert daraus Mini Bluey.

Mama muss Bluey eine allerletzte Geschichte vorlesen, da sie ansonsten nicht einschlafen kann. Ihre Geschichte wird allerdings von dem schrägen Gemeinhorn unterbrochen, das die nervigste Handpuppe auf der ganzen Welt ist.
Als sie Curry holen, müssen Bingo und Dad einer Elster trotzen, die ihr Nest beschützt.

Bingo lernt von Bluey, wie man Mama so verzaubert, dass sie mit einem spielen will. Bluey hat dabei allerdings die wichtigste aller Regeln vergessen, dass man Zauberei nicht dafür nutzt, kleine Ungezogenheiten auszuüben.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Vincent Asa ist der größte Fan des Rockstars Jagged Stone und schleicht sich in Jaggeds Hotel, um ihn um ein Foto zu bitten. Als er aus dem Hotel geschmissen wird, nutzt Hawk Moth Vincents Wut und verwandelt ihn in den Pixelator.

Vor langer Zeit haben sich die Drachen in der Welt von Kumandra selbst geopfert, um die Menschheit vor unheimlichen Monstern, bekannt als die Druun, zu retten. Nun, 500 Jahre später, kehren diese Monster zurück und es liegt an der Kriegerin Raya, den letzten Drachen zu finden, um die Druun aufzuhalten. Auf ihrer Reise lernt sie jedoch, dass es mehr als einen Drachen benötigt, um das Schicksal zu beeinflussen und wieder Frieden nach Kumandra zu bringen.

Mulans alter, kranker Vater soll in die Armee eingezogen werden, um die einfallenden Mongolen zu bekämpfen. Da er in seinem Zustand die Strapazen des Krieges nicht überleben würde, verkleidet sich die junge Mulan als Mann und gibt sich als ihr Vater aus. Ihre Vorfahren sind mit diesem Plan nicht einverstanden und schicken deshalb den kleinen Drachen Mushu hinterher, um sie von ihrem Vorhaben abzubringen. Doch als er Mulan begegnet, schlägt er sich auf ihre Seite.

Der geschiedene Scott bekommt am Weihnachtsabend Besuch von seinem Sohn Charlie. Als er ihn zu Bett bringen will, sehen sie Santa Claus vom Dach fallen. Dieser verschwindet zwar, doch seine Kleidung und eine Karte bleiben zurück. Auf der Karte steht, dass wer auch immer Santas Mantel nach dessen Tode trägt, zum neuen Santa wird. Scott und Charlie fahren daraufhin mit Santas Rentierschlitten zum Nordpol, wo der Weihnachtself Bernard Scott unterrichtet. So beginnt ein wundersames Abenteuer.

Als Claires Bauanfrage für den Hinterhof abgelehnt wird, kennen nur Phil und Luke den wahren Grund. Derweil verrät Pameron Cam ein Familiengeheimnis. Dieser ist dermaßen schockiert, dass er sich Hilfe von einem Therapeuten holt.

Als Phil starke Bauchschmerzen hat, bringt Gloria ihn für eine Notoperation ins Krankenhaus und versammelt die ganze Familie an seiner Seite. Unterdessen ist Cam wütend auf Mitchell, da sich dieser für einen anderen Mann interessiert.

Im Eros-Center kommt es zu einem Mord. Eine junge Frau namens Biggi wurde ermordet. Die Polizei hat schnell drei Hauptverdächtige. Zum einen ist da ihr italienischer Freund. Riccardo und sie haben sich angeblich am Abend vor ihrem Tod gestritten. Ein Rechtsanwalt war Kunde bei Biggi und diese hat seine perversen Wünsche wohl nicht mitmachen wollen. Außerdem ist da noch ein amerikanischer Journalist. Der hat an einer Reportage gearbeitet und alles dafür getan, um an Material zu kommen.

Two teachers head out on a double date, but when they run into familiar bar patrons, it proves to be an unfortunate distraction; at Ava's first book club meeting, the group ends up in a debate over who would be the best post-apocalyptic leader.
A recent transfer student named Diggs (Daniel Radcliffe) rescues Bart from a confrontation with bullies.
Erica thinks her singing dreams have come true when she lands a job at a new karaoke bar in town. Murray teaches Barry and Lainey financial responsibility.
When Adam tells Beverly he doesn't want her to chaperone the school trip to a theme park, his mother tries to manipulate him with `guilt letters'.
Phil is invited to appear on the local news in a real estate segment and Jay is helping Manny prepare his video interview for college applications.
Halloween parties create hilarious mishaps and confrontations as everyone tries to get through the scary night.
pr.sub: Halloween 4: The Revenge of Rod Skyhook

pr.d: Phil considers becoming a member at Jay's favourite place of refuge. Claire is mistaken about her influence on Alex's choices. Cam refrains from telling Mitchell what his play is really about.
It's Vegas baby. Groom Simon and best man Anthony sit down and pour over the decisions that led to Simon gambling it all on an explosive Las Vegas wedding to bride Kayleigh.

Short cheeky clips feature ducks going up an escalator, animal impressions, a few narrow escapes on a snowboard and rally driving. Plus, some interesting food clips with an energy drink house prank, and a butcher rap.
Cheeky original clips featuring ducks going up an escalator, animal impressions, a few narrow escapes on a snowboard and rally driving. Plus: an energy drink house prank and a butcher rap.
Billy plans a pig-themed wedding involving a world record parade of porkers, but prim Steph may kick up a stink at his plans.
Aussie-born Adam is taking a risk planning an '80s Aussie soap' wedding when bride-to-be Rachel is hoping for something classy and sophisticated.

Beks learns the truth from Freddy about the lovebite on his neck. Will Jazz's moment of comfort with Inga affect her relationship with Eve? And after hearing that Jules' mother has been hinting at grandchildren, Tristan asks James Taylor for advice.

Gordon visits Italian bistro Charlie's in La Verne, Southern California, which was bought in 2010 by Tatiana Leiva, her mother and her sister. Tatiana didn't actually put any money into the purchase herself, but her hard-working mother and sister did because they felt they were helping to fulfil Tatiana's dream. They even put up their houses as collateral! Unfortunately, soon Charlie's was in trouble.

Gordon Ramsay travels to Baltimore to try to turn around a restaurant that is suffering because its owner, Denise Whiting, has managed to alienate the surrounding community. When Denise opened Café Hon in 1992 it was a roaring success, but as a result of her unwavering business ambition the local community decided to boycott the restaurant, leaving Denise frustrated by falling sales.

Gordon Ramsay travels to South Philadelphia to try to turn around family-run restaurant Chiarella's, which is struggling to survive in an area full of thriving Italian establishments. That isn't the only problem facing owners Tommy and Dina Defino. Their marriage is on the verge of collapse.
Chef Ramsay returns to restaurants he tried to help in the past, such as Downcity in Providence, RI, Classic American in West Babylon, NY, and Davide in Boston to check on their progress.
Chef Ramsay revisits La Frite, Kingston Cafe, Capri and Spanish Pavilion to see if the owners succeeded in following his advice.

When a straight-laced fire superintendent and his elite team of firefighters come to the rescue of three siblings, they quickly realize that no amount of training could prepare them for their most challenging job yet - babysitting.

When Homer gets kicked out of an all-you-can-eat seafood restaurant for eating too much, he takes the owner to court. The restaurant offers a peace deal: Homer can eat all the food he likes so long as people can gawk at him like a freak in return. Meanwhile, Bart falls in love with his babysitter.
Homer becomes a neighbourhood hero when, after wrecking his car in the snow, he buys a snowplough and clears his neighbours' driveways.

The family struggles to get Maggie to say her first word. Homer says he's glad that Maggie has not spoken yet because all Lisa and Bart do is talk back to him, but after he puts Maggie to bed, she says her first word.
When Homer learns he needs a heart bypass operation after having a heart attack at work, he searches for the cheapest doctor.

When Springfield decides to install a monorail system, Homer gets the job as conductor, but has no idea what he's doing, although he does get to wear a cape. When the monorail opens, all hell breaks loose, and it's down to Homer and Bart to save the passengers.
After Homer gets sick from a giant sandwich he's been eating for months, Aunt Selma steps in to take the kids to a new alcohol-based theme park, with near-disastrous consequences.

When Homer leaves Bart by the squid port and strangers take pity on the street urchin, giving him money, Homer and Bart turn to a life of scamming. They scam Dr Hibbert and Ned Flanders, and Grampa even helps them con his fellow retirement home residents, but are they accomplished enough to avoid detection?

The Great British Bake Off celebrates Christmas 2022 with five famous faces from Channel 4's history. Gaby Roslin, Sir Tony Robinson, Miquita Oliver, Terry Christian and Claire Sweeney enter the tent, each hoping to win Christmas Star Baker.
Gaby Roslin, Sir Tony Robinson, Miquita Oliver, Terry Christian and Claire Sweeney compete for Christmas Star Baker, and the English National Ballet perform the beautiful Swan Lake.

The nation's favourite armchair critics cast their eyes over 2023's top Christmas telly, including 'The Real Full Monty: Jingle Bells', 'The Repair Shop Christmas Special', 'The 1% Club Christmas Special', 'Fur Babies', 'Love Actually' and more.
The Goggleboxers check out top Christmas telly, from The Real Full Monty: Jingle Bells to An Audience with Kylie, The 1% Club Christmas Special, Fur Babies, Men Up and Love Actually.

This week, the Goggleboxers have been watching 'Britain's Got Talent', 'Married at First Sight Australia', 'Chess Masters: The Endgame', 'The Au Pair', 'This Morning', 'The Americas', 'Inside the Four Seasons Park Lane' and 'With Love, Meghan'.
Charlotte Ritchie climbs a ladder with some loo roll, Mike Wozniak tries out a new catchphrase, and Lee Mack terrifies an innocent member of the public.
Jimmy Carr hosts as Rob Beckett and Aisling Bea are joined by competing panellists Kerry Godliman, Georgia Toffolo, Kiri Pritchard-McLean and Fin Taylor.

In Portsmouth, Claire and Alex, Jack and Robyn, and Elle and Graham compete in an edition that features organic fare, glitter and sparkle, and some school dinner comparisons.

Maddi and her husband Givon start the competition with a menu inspired by their Sri Lankan heritage. Second to host are Kate and Dan who prepare a night of rustic Italian cooking, and finally it's time for Ali and John to step up to the plate.
pr.sub: Couples: Portsmouth & The Isle of Wight

pr.d: In an edition from Portsmouth and the Isle of Wight, Maddi and Givon serve fine champagne and fusion food, Kate and Dan play it safe, and Ali and John's risky menu causes kitchen chaos.

When Ilca and Fernando bought their starter home it was just the two of them. However, ten years and three kids later, they are juggling childcare, an in-home salon, and a long list of unfinished DIY.
...Selling: Ilca and Fernando's house doubles as an in-home salon. Jonathan aims to beautify the place. That is, until Fernando swings a sledgehammer in the wrong place...
Newlyweds and empty-nesters Lisa and Dave are ready to downsize, and they are looking for an open-concept suburban palace where they can entertain their big blended family in style.
...Selling: Lisa and Dave aim to downsize, but still want room for both entertaining and Lisa's business. So, when they extend their budget, Drew has fun finding their dream home.

In the year that same-sex marriage became legal in England, former drama student Jack from Essex is hoping to impress his husband-to-be James by putting on the performance of a lifetime, as well as a wedding.

In this Christmas Special, a loving couple from Rotherham switch roles as the groom takes on all wedding planning responsibility. Steve gets 12,000 pounds and three weeks to plan a wedding with an icy twist.
pr.sub: Emma and Steve; Let it Snow

pr.t: Don't Tell the Bride: Let It Snow
pr.d: Steve from Rotherham plans a wedding with an icy twist for his bride Emma, who wants an impressive, upmarket affair. But will his big ideas leave him snowed under?

Wannabe superstar DJ Luke wants a huge rave for his wedding to bride-to-be Ellis, while all Ellis wants is a quiet church ceremony. But with a mother-in-law to impress and laid-back Luke leaving everything to the last minute, can he and party animal best man Tom get this party started?
pr.sub: The One with the Wannabe DJ Groom

pr.d: Club Med Europe Africa Middle East CEO Xavier Mufraggi goes undercover at his holiday parks.
Wan Kim, CEO of Smoothie King, goes undercover at one of his stores.

In Beaver, Pennsylvania, where he finds a brother-and-sister team who are unable to work together positively at an Italian restaurant called Levanti's. Their relationship is so fractured that they are failing to save their father's business from being overwhelmed by competition from other local eateries. The situation has become desperate, and dad Tony is now in danger of losing his life savings.

Gordon visits family-owned restaurant Sam's Mediterranean Kabob Room in Monrovia, California. Within minutes of his arrival, Gordon is caught in the crossfire of an argument between owner Sam, his wife and their children, all of whom are feeling the pressure of working in the restaurant seven days a week.

Gordon heads to Long Beach, California, to save Nino's, an Italian family restaurant that was opened in 1958 and is now under the misguided leadership of the eldest son, Nino. Younger brother Michael and sister Carina point the finger of blame for the restaurant's failings directly at Nino, and their 78-year-old mother Inge is desperate for Nino to turn the business around.

Gordon heads to Norwalk, Ohio, in America's farming heartland, for the first of two visits to the Mill Street Bistro. There he encounters Joe Nagy, one of the most pretentious restaurant owners he has ever met.
In the dramatic conclusion to the Mill Street Bistro saga, Gordon's disagreement with proprietor Joe Nagy erupts into one of his most intense confrontations yet.

Jimmy Carr hosts, with Sean Lock and Jason Manford going up against guest captain Sarah Millican, and Jonathan Ross. Bill Bailey joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner while Rachel Riley looks after the letters and the numbers.

...Joe Lycett: In his award-winning stand up show, Joe Lycett lampoons everything from tyrannical Post Office jobsworths to the stupidity of celebrities on Twitter.

Brand new series - Double Date: Jacob and Gregory go on a double date, but they run into some familiar faces. Ava's first book club meet turns into a post-apocalyptic debate.

Rad!: Erica thinks her singing dreams have come true when she lands a job at a new karaoke bar in town. Murray teaches Barry and Lainey financial responsibility.

Weathering Heights: Phil's excited when he's invited onto the local news. And his day gets even better when he meets his weatherman hero, Rainer Shine (guest star Nathan Fillion).

(2019) Fun-filled family comedy starring John Cena. A macho fireman has to babysit three impish kids after saving them from a blaze in the remote California woodlands.
New Kid on the Block: When Homer gets kicked out of an all-you-can-eat seafood restaurant for eating too much, he takes the owner to court.
Mr Plow: Homer impulsively buys a snow plough and sets up in business as Mr Plow. But when Barney declares himself the Plow King, their rivalry spirals out of control.
Lisa's First Word: The family try to get Maggie to say her first word. But Homer's glad that she hasn't spoken yet, because all Lisa and Bart do is talk back to him.
Homer's Triple Bypass: Homer has a heart attack while he's watching TV. The hospital says he needs a bypass, but Homer can't afford it. Of course, there's always Dr Nick...

Three of Scotland's finest chefs do battle for a chance to cook at the banquet celebrating 50 Years of Popular Music. Gordon Jones, the only newcomer, faces returners Lorna McNee and Ben Reade, who are going head-to-head for the second time.

The chefs cook their mains and desserts, each battling to produce smash hit dishes that wow their veteran. For her main, Lorna is confident her lamb dish `With A Little Help From My Friends', dedicated to supportive friends, is a celebratory dish fit for the banquet.

The two remaining Scottish chefs must cook their four courses again, but this time they'll need to appeal to four new palates. Food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton, broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver plus a celebrity guest judge.

Emily Scott is the chef proprietor of Cornwall's renowned 'St Tudy Inn'. Her two rivals are from across the sea on Jersey. Joe Baker is largely self-taught, but at just 28 already running his own restaurant, 'No 10', in St Helier. A neighbouring restaurant is Michelin starred 'Samphire' where Lee Smith is head chef.

Emily's David Bowie-inspired dish celebrates Britain's food heroes, and she uses Cornish duck meat from her local producer that she pairs with grilled radicchio and Malbec sauce. Meanwhile, Joe has also sourced his ingredients locally.

The chefs need to impress the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate. They are joined by one half of the synthpop duo The Communards, Reverend Richard Coles.

Tom "Westy" Westerland is a former National Chef of Wales and head chef of the Brasserie at Lucknam Park in Wiltshire. Cindy Challoner is the former head chef at prestigious teaching restaurant "The Classroom" in Cardiff. They face Andy Sheridan formerly of Sosban restaurant in Llanelli, returning to the competition for his second attempt at making it to the banquet.

Andy cooks venison in celebration of his favourite band, Oasis. He accompanies the loin with rhubarb and beetroot ketchup, black pudding purée, pickled beetroot and a pistachio crumb. Westy's beef dish 'The Cow Shed' is named after a former stage at the Glastonbury Festival.
The two remaining chefs from Wales must cook their four-course menus again. They must take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their tributes to Britain's music success.

The three chefs begin by cooking their starters for a surprise veteran of the competition. Chris' dish `Brixton Academy Through the Years' is his refined take on the classic lamb, post-gig junk food he ate after nights out at Brixton Academy.

Chris is cooking his interpretation of the classic beef dish Tournedos Rossini using guinea fowl. His inspiration is Proms in the Park and the British artists who mix classical and modern music styles. Alex's dish commemorates his late brother and the song by Northern Ireland artist Donna Taggart that he associates with the difficult time of his death.

The two remaining chefs from Northern Ireland recreate their four-course menu for the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver. There is also a guest judge: rapper Loyle Carner.

The chefs battle to get their starter course to the Abbey Road banquet and don't disappoint with dishes dedicated to everything from Tom Jones to grime. The rivals are cooking to impress Matthew Fort, Oliver Peyton, and Andi Oliver.

Some of the finest chefs in the UK compete to cook a fish course worthy of serving at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road Studios. Along with the show's panel of expert judges, the rivals need to impress guest judge Kanya King.

The eight regional champions will compete to get their main courses onto the final menu of the banquet at Abbey Road Studios. They will be cooking for the judges' food critic, Matthew Fort, cook and broadcaster Andi Oliver and restaurateur, Oliver Peyton plus guest judge, former Wham! star, Andrew Ridgeley. As ever, the judges will be looking for dishes laced with star quality and a good sprinkling of rock and roll wow factor worthy of a banquet full of the music industry's finest.

Some of the country's finest chefs compete over the final place cooking at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road studios. Each rival will need to cook a dessert to impress a panel of expert judges, along with guest judge Peter Hook, Joy Division and New Order bassist, and pioneer of Britain's Madchester scene.

The chefs must cook in an unfamiliar kitchen and scale up their dishes to provide the highest calibre of dining for a full banquet room of diners. Their guests are celebrities and unsung heroes who have helped create British music's unparalleled global reputation.

Three of Scotland's top chefs, Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee, and Graham Campbell - attempt to impress this week's veteran judge. Having missed out last year, returning finalist Jak is determined to make it to the banquet.

Scottish chefs Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee and Graham Campbell fight it out for the fish course. Graham is in a confident mood but returning finalist Jak and self-taught Jimmy are pushing him hard. Will the pressure prove too much for ambitious Graham?

Scottish chefs Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee and Graham Campbell are battling to plate up a perfect main course for this week's veteran chef. Self-taught Jimmy is honouring his mum with his rendition of her Chinese beef stew.

Today it's the Scottish chefs' last chance to impress, with the dessert course. Only two can cook for the judges tomorrow, and with one chef in the lead after a triumphant main, the pressures on for the other two to plate up perfection.

The two remaining Scottish chefs cook their entire menus again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by WI Calendar Girl Angela Baker, who will help decide which chef will go forward to the National Finals.

Three of the south-west's finest chefs, Jude Kereama, Josh Eggleton and Dominic Chapman attempt to impress a veteran judge with their starters. As the only newcomer, Jude is determined to plate up a winning dish, but he faces stiff competition.

The three south-west chefs fight it out for the fish course. Despite schoolboy errors during the starter, experienced Dominic is determined to get a high score on the course. But will newcomer Jude, a seafood master, overcome his nerves to plate up?
It's a battle for the main course as the three south-west chefs go head-to-head. Newcomer Jude is brimming with determination and confidence as the main course battle hits the kitchen.

The south-west chefs have one last chance to impress as they face the dessert course. Only two chefs can go through to cook for the judges with everything to play for, who will plate up perfection and who will be sent packing?

The two remaining south-west judges must cook their entire menus again for judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. Joining the judges is Radhika Bynon, a member of the Forest Gate Women's Institute, a modern urban group of women.

A documentary that sheds light on the Holocaust experience from the perspective of six women imprisoned in the Auschwitz-Birkenau concentration camp. The film demonstrates the Nazis' failure to crush the will of Jews. The women profiled do not dwell on the physical and emotional hardships. Instead, they speak of camp families and faith, and the ways in which they tried to encourage one another and retain their humanity in the face of unimaginable evil.

Germany is in decline. Once the world's most powerful country is now being devastated by WWII. Adolf Hitler has gone into hiding. The dreaded ruler is no longer openly supporting his people. He is slowly losing his mind.

pr.t: The Strange World of the German Dictator
pr.d: Explore the complexities of the man who would become one of history's most infamous figures. From his obscure beginnings in Austria to his meteoric rise as Germany's Führer, dive deep into the forces that shaped Hitler's ideology and his leadership.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: This documentary programme uses archival footage, interviews and dramatic reconstructions to tell the story of the rise of the Nazis through time as well as the continued rise of Neo-Nazis. `The Rise of the Nazi Party' reveals how the National Socialists exploited economic turmoil to get into power in Germany in 1933 before leading the nation into an era of genocide and military defeat. It profiles the people who helped the Nazis bring destruction to Europe, including Hitler, Himmler and Goebbels.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: As punishment for the 1923 'Putsch', Hitler is banned from public speaking. Now he employs Joseph Goebbels to feed Hitler's political ideology to the masses.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: Hitler seizes his chance in the wake of The Great Depression, turning the people on the incumbent Democratic Weimar Government and promising a brighter future.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: A month after coming to power, Hitler addresses his people through the radio. He promises to make the economy his priority - and the task ahead is massive.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: Hitler summons Germany's military leaders to a shock meeting at his headquarters. He lays out his plans for military expansion into neighbouring territories.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: Investigate Hitler's biggest mistake, and explore how the German people begin to see through the facade of the Nazi propaganda machine.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: Explore how Adolf Hitler and the Nazi Party groomed the German people into thinking the genocide of Jewish people was a morally correct decision.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: Explore how with Nazi Germany on the back foot, Hitler's attempts to cling to power become ever more desperate, leading to ever more deplorable consequences.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: Explore how the Allies final advance on Nazi Germany in January 1945 sounded the death knell for the Third Reich, a regime which continued with its lies to the very end.

In the darkest days of World War II in the Pacific, an elite British military team sought to facilitate espionage and sabotage behind enemy lines. This now famous group, the British Special Operations Executive or MI6, faced a critical obstacle.
Kevin Sempé dives in search of wrecks harking back to the Roman Empire's greatness. The journey begins with the Nave Romana.
pr.sub: Shipwrecked Sailors Of The Roman Empire

pr.d: Kevin Sempé explores the bay of Saint-Pierre in Martinique, where ships smouldered and sank following the devastating volcanic eruption of 1902.

The history of modern China is told from the birth of the republic in 1911, through the civil war, the bloody Japanese occupation, the rise to power of Mao and the Communist Party, the Cultural Revolution, to the present day.
pr.sub: Chinese Revolution - Modern World, Modern Emperors

pr.d: Explore how the Polynesians spread across the Pacific and examine the cultures they took with them while constructing elaborate temples to their beliefs.

Alice visits Canterbury for the story of Plantagenet England. Canterbury is steeped in history and the era of the Plantagenets - the strong house that held the English throne from 1154 until 1485 - saw the most dramatic episodes in the city's story.
Alice Roberts explores the story of Stewart Britain by visiting Stirling, the home of the Scottish royals who eventually took the English throne in 1603 and created Great Britain.
In Norwich, the UK's most Tudor city, Professor Alice Roberts learns about religious intolerance, uncovers the Norwich FC canary's origins and experiences humiliating Tudor justice.

Edinburgh's handsome hilltop bastion is Scotland's most popular paid tourist attraction. With a slew of sieges to its name, it is no surprise that the site boasts some formidable defences, and Dan puts one heavy-duty cannon through its paces.

Dan Jones explores the history of Cardiff Castle over more than 2,000 years and reveals how it became transformed from a strategically important Roman and Norman stronghold to a lavish fairy-tale Victorian home.

In medieval England, the North was ruled from York. Dan Jones explores the history of its castle, from the Viking Jorvik and the Normans, through the dark days of the anti-Jewish pogrom and the imprisonment of the Knights Templar, to one of its most colourful inmates - the legendary highwayman Dick Turpin.

With the aid of dramatic reconstruction, Dan Jones explores the 900-year history of the beautiful Leeds Castle in Kent, from its origins as a royal Saxon family's manor and Norman stronghold to the private property of six medieval queens, a Tudor palace, a Jacobean country house, a Georgian mansion and an elegant 20th-century retreat for the rich and famous.

Dan Jones visits Lancaster Castle to explore its grisly history of crime and punishment, including the infamous Lancashire Witches trials and the martyrdom of the Jesuit priest Saint Edmund Arrowsmith.
Dan Jones visits the heart of the English countryside to explore Arundel Castle and the dramatic history of the Earls of Arundel.

Dan explores behind the battlements of Dover Castle and descends into an underground lair. There, he discovers how a vast network of tunnels had been used to defend both the castle and the country for centuries.

Built by William the Conqueror, the Tower of London is one of Britain's most iconic landmarks. It has been a military fortress, a palace, a royal mint, a prison, a zoo and a place of execution, a silent witness to some of the most momentous events in our history. Dan Jones reveals some of its fascinating secrets and tells the stories of the traitors, rebels and royalty who met their end inside its imposing walls.

Dan is in the heart of the English countryside at Warwick Castle. While it appears idyllic today, for centuries it was a poisoned chalice to the Earls of Warwick who lived there and its walls echo with tales of betrayal, bloodshed and murder.
Historian Dan Jones is in the heart of Snowdonia exploring a stronghold built not only as an impenetrable fortress but also as a lavish royal palace fit for a fairytale - Caernarfon Castle.

Situated high on a crag overlooking the river Forth, Stirling Castle has guarded the gateway to the Scottish Highlands for centuries. The residence of kings, armies and felons, its battle-scarred walls have witnessed savagery and chivalry, intrigue, alchemy, adultery and murder. Location filming, stunning aerial shots and reconstructions bring to life its turbulent history.

Jack beginnt seine Reise in Nebraska und besichtigt ein aufwendig renoviertes Raketensilo. Danach besucht er ein märchenhaftes Cottage mit Hollywood-Vergangenheit und entdeckt zum Abschluss in Las Vegas ein außergewöhnliches Paradies für Autofans.

Jack besichtigt in Palm Springs das ehemalige Zuhause einer Hollywood-Legende. Dann reist er ins Goldgräberland und entdeckt eine ungewöhnliche Lösung für Stauraum, bevor es an den Lake Tahoe geht, wo nachhaltiges Bauen im Mittelpunkt steht.

Jacks Reise führt ihn zu drei weiteren außergewöhnlichen Häusern. Er entdeckt ein Haus mit musikalischer Inspiration, besucht eine Siedlung aus Erdkuppelbauten in der Wüste und wirft schließlich einen Blick in ein Anwesen mit königlichem Flair.

Jack besichtigt eine Kirche, die zu einem Wohnhaus umgebaut wurde. Danach besucht er ein farbenfrohes Haus in der kalifornischen Wüste und entdeckt schließlich ein historisches Gebäude, das eine völlig neue Bestimmung als Zuhause gefunden hat.

Im mittleren Westen tourt Retta durch drei abscheuliche Häuser, die um die Chance auf eine Renovierung wetteifern. Sie erhält einen Einblick in einen Unterwasser-Seepalast, einen Rückfall aus den 1960er-Jahren und ein ehemaliges Bestattungsinstitut.

Retta ist in den Südosten unterwegs, um sich die hässliche Heimkonkurrenz anzusehen. Retta erkundet ein Sardinenbüchsenhaus mit einem Schlangenproblem, ein Anwesen mit einer fragwürdigen Vergangenheit und ein Haus, das wie eine alte Bank aussieht.

Retta begibt sich in den Nordosten, um die abscheulichste Heimat der Region aufzudecken. Sie stellt das Leben infrage und entwirft Entscheidungen in einer ehemaligen Vorschule, einem Haus in Pyramidenform und einem Albtraum mit rosa Teppich.

Retta findet einen dunklen Fleck an der sonnigen Westküste, als sie drei Häuser untersucht, die eher Albträumen als Träumen ähneln. Sie besucht ein Dschungelhaus, ein Haus, das früher eine Scheune war und ein Boot ähnliches Anwesen.

Greg hat kaum Geld und schläft auf dem Sofa eines Freundes - bis er mit einem Rubbellos eine Million Dollar gewinnt. Davon möchte er maximal 200.000 Dollar in sein Traumhaus investieren, das ein großes Grundstück und vier Schlafzimmer haben soll.

Der alleinerziehende Vater Todd investiert spontan 10 Dollar in einen Lottoautomaten. Kurz darauf erfährt er, dass er 700.000 Dollar gewonnen hat. Todd will direkt aus seiner kleinen Mietwohnung in Louisville, Kentucky, in ein Eigenheim ziehen.

Der Junggeselle Scott will in San Francisco, Kalifornien, neu anfangen und seine Wohnsituation verkleinern. In Begleitung seiner Freundin Christina hofft Scott, ein Minihaus zu finden, das mehr als 35 Quadratmeter hat, ein helles Ambiente und ein separates Schlafzimmer. Er sieht sich Häuser mit dazugehörigen Grundstücken an und würde gern in der Stadt bleiben. Doch sogar mit seinem Budget von 500.000 Dollar könnte es schwer werden, auf dem teuersten Immobilienmarkt der USA etwas zu finden.

Melody und Ben aus Frisco, Texas, sind oft monatelang in Afrika. Dort bauen sie mit ihrer gemeinnützigen Organisation Häuser für die Armen. Da ihre vier Kinder schon erwachsen sind, wollen sich Melody und Ben verkleinern, damit sie weniger Arbeit mit dem Haus haben, wenn sie von ihren Reisen zurückkehren. Melody will etwas Traditionelles mit einem großzügigen Wohnbereich für die Besuche der Kinder, aber Ben wünscht sich ein noch kleineres Haus mit einem Hütten-Feeling.

Richard aus Dallas hat sich dazu entschieden, sein Wohnraum zu verkleinern und hat sich deswegen ein Tiny House gekauft. Dadurch erhofft er sich mehr Freiheit, das zu tun, was er liebt, wie zum Beispiel Fahrradfahren oder sein eigenes Bier brauen.

Die Besitzer eines New Yorker Bed and Breakfast wollen ein Tiny House auf sein Grundstück setzen. Dadurch erhoffen sie sich mehr Gäste, da sie in das neue Haus ziehen würden und die Gäste dadurch das gesamte alte Bauernhaus benutzen können.

Heather und Beau suchen nach einem Haus im Topanga Canyon, in dem sie ihren Sohn in Ruhe aufziehen können. Jedoch kommt es schnell zu Auseinandersetzungen, da Heather einen Bohemian-Chic-Stil will, Beau aber eine rustikale Hütte bevorzugt.

Ashley und ihr Ehemann Travis führen ein Globetrotter-Leben. Deshalb konnten sie nie ihre eigene Wohnung aussuchen. Nun ist die Familie mit den drei Kindern auf dem Weg nach Sansibar, Tansania. Doch Ashley und Travis haben verschiedene Prioritäten.

Die hügelige Landschaft von Kinsale in Florida erinnert Kimberley an Irland, wo ihre Familie herkommt. Mit Peter sucht sie das richtige Haus, denn Peter will ein Buch schreiben und braucht dafür einerseits Anregung, aber auch die nötige Ruhe.

Es klingt so einfach: In ein anderes Land gehen und ein neues Leben anfangen. Das fängt bei einem Haus und die damit verbundenen Bestimmungen sind oft sehr anders als gewohnt. Haussucher blicken auf Baustile, Bürokratie und Besonderheiten.

pr.d: Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.
Die Familie feiert zum achten Mal Weihnachten im Schloss, sie lädt Menschen ein, die geholfen haben.

Mit dem Start der neuen Saison stehen im Château zahlreiche Veränderungen an. Tochter Dorothy soll ihr eigenes Zimmer bekommen, weshalb Dick und Angel die Schlafräume neu organisieren und eine aufwendige Zimmersuite neu gestalten.

Mit den steigenden Temperaturen verlagert sich das Familienleben nach draußen. Dick und Angel verwirklichen den Bau eines neuen Pools und widmen sich der Gestaltung der Außenanlagen. Natürlich kommt auch die französische Küche nicht zu kurz.

Der Sommer steht auf dem Château ganz im Zeichen von Gastfreundschaft und gemeinsamen Erlebnissen: Dick und Angel empfangen viele Gäste, bereiten festliche Menüs zu und schaffen dabei besondere Momente mit ihren Liebsten.

John Stamos überrascht seinen besten Freund aus Schulzeiten mit einer umfassenden Umgestaltung der Garage. Gemeinsam mit Jonathan und Drew verwandelt er den Ort, an dem sie ihre Jugend verbracht haben.
Jonathan und Drew gestalten für Laurences Freund ein Refugium im Hinterhof auf Resortniveau.

Die Studienfreundin der Komikerin Ali Wong, Zitadelle, ist eine berufstätige Mutter, die ihr Zuhause und ihr Herz jedem öffnet. Ali erwidert die Liebe, indem sie Zitadelles kargen Keller in das unterhaltsame Herz ihres Zuhauses verwandelt.

Im Süden der USA stehen drei düstere Häuser im Finale: ein Gangster-Versteck, ein historisches Anwesen voller Hexen und Geister sowie ein Haus, das von seltsamen Kreaturen bewohnt wird. Sie alle kämpfen um eine Renovierung im Wert von 150.000 Dollar.

Drei Spukhäuser stellen sich dem Wettbewerb um die große Renovierung: Ein Haus mit tödlicher Einrichtung, ein Keller voller Geister und eine Kirche, die von Gräbern umgeben ist, sorgen für Gänsehaut. Welches Haus wird in ein Traumdomizil verwandelt?

Im Nordosten der USA treten drei furchteinflößende Häuser gegeneinander an, um eine Renovierung im Wert von 150.000 Dollar zu gewinnen. Zur Wahl steht ein Haus mit einem unheimlichen Brunnen in der Küche und ein Gebäude voller gefährlicher Fallen.

Diesmal fällt die Entscheidung: Welches Haus ist das gruseligste Haus in Amerika? Die Moderatorin Retta verkündet das Gewinnerpaar, und Designerin Alison Victoria verwandelt das schaurigste Gebäude in ein stilvolles Zuhause.
Drei der gruseligsten Häuser im Osten der USA treten gegeneinander an und hoffen auf eine Renovierung im Wert von 150.000 Dollar durch Alison Victoria.

Wir werfen einen Blick auf ein Paar aus Miami, das sich den Traum vom Eigenheim erfüllt hat. Nach Jahren in Mietwohnungen haben sie ihr erstes Haus gekauft. Mithilfe von Freunden und Familie wollen sie es in ein Wohlfühlparadies verwandeln.

Eine Mutter, die einen neuen Lebensabschnitt beginnt, möchte mehr Zeit mit ihren Kindern am Strand verbringen. Sie nutzt ihre Fähigkeiten als pensionierte Kunstlehrerin, um bei der Renovierung ihres Ferienhauses in Ocean City, NJ, zu helfen.

Ein Paar aus Michigan zieht nach St. Croix, um ein aktiveres Leben am Meer zu führen. Sie träumt von einer Wohnung mit spektakulärem Ausblick, während er skeptisch ist, ob sich die hohen Kosten dafür lohnen. Wie entscheiden sie sich?

Ein junges Paar mit Kleinkind wagt den Umzug nach St. Thomas, um das entspannte Leben auf der Insel zu genießen. Doch sie stehen vor einer schwierigen Entscheidung: Soll es ein bezugsfertiges Haus oder ein renovierungsbedürftiges Zuhause sein.

Nachdem ihre Wohnung auf Hawaii von Lava zerstört wurde, wagt ein Paar einen Neustart auf St. Thomas. Während sie vor allem den tropischen Lebensstil genießt, sorgt er sich um die finanzielle Belastung. Der Hauskauf wird zur Bewährungsprobe.

Nach vielen Urlauben in der Karibik zieht eine Familie dauerhaft nach Roatan in Honduras. Sie lieben das Klima, die Strände und die Freizeitmöglichkeiten, doch ihr Traum muss sich auch rechnen. Deshalb suchen sie ein Haus mit Mietpotenzial.

Ein abenteuerlustiges Paar verlässt die Kälte und zieht nach Roatan, Honduras. Da ihre Familie zu Besuch kommen soll, brauchen sie viel Platz und ein Haus mit Vermietungspotenzial. Er ist bereit, in einen Neubau zu investieren.

Ein Ehepaar aus New York mit sieben Kindern will in Roatan ein neues Leben beginnen. Gesucht wird ein großes Grundstück am Strand, das nicht nur genügend Platz für die Familie bietet, sondern auch Mieteinnahmen generiert.

pr.t: Home Rescue - Wohnen in der Wildnis
pr.d: In Arkansas benötigt eine Siedlerfamilie dringend Hilfe. Im Spätwinter schlägt das Wetter in den unwirtlichen Ozark Mountains gnadenlos zu. Ashli und Chris Curry sind die Aufgaben längst über den Kopf gewachsen: Es mangelt an Trinkwasser.

A chiropodist, two part-time gardeners and a woman who works on projects in between the school run are today's investors. They've bought property in Bullbridge in Derbyshire, Newcastle-under-Lyme in Staffordshire and Wolverhampton in the West Midlands under the hammer.

Martin Roberts follows the progress of a couple developing a chalet bungalow in Drakelowe in Staffordshire for their family, while Lucy Alexander talks to a young entrepreneur with grand plans for a three-bed semi in Croydon in London. Dion Dublin looks round a piece of land which runs alongside a tourist steam train track in Coltishall in Norfolk.

Martin Roberts rolls back the clock nearly 12 years to catch up on an ambitious development of a former church in Preston on the Hill in Cheshire, while Lucy Alexander looks round two very different terraced houses in Stony Stratford, near Milton Keynes, and Streatham in London.

A 1930s terrace in Croydon, a semi in Wolstanton destined to be a family home and the only house on a street in Moorside in Oldham are all under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion visit the properties and meet the new owners.

Dion visits a stone cottage in Tilton on the Hill in rural Leicestershire, Martin is at a property auction in Croydon on the outskirts of London, and Lucy meets two friends who have bought a bungalow in Rainham in Kent.

A mid-terrace house in Chaddesden in Derby, a two-bedroom flat in London's Maida Vale and a property in Warrington are all sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the new owners to hear what they have planned for their auction buys.

Martin looks round a pretty cottage with outbuildings with huge potential in Burton upon Trent, while Lucy checks out a flat in London's ⚽ [EPL] Crystal Palace and Dion is in Mossley near Manchester in a four-bedroom bungalow.

Martin tackles the issue of solar panels on a property in Mountain Ash in Wales and wonders if it will be a sunny outcome for the new owner, while Lucy looks round a barn in Elstree in Hertfordshire and Dion visits a flat in Newport in Shropshire.

Martin Roberts meets a couple who buy a former mill workers' cottage in Derbyshire as their first home together, Lucy Alexander meets a father and daughter team who are seasoned developers buying a house in Kent, and Dion Dublin talks to a man who, along with two friends, has clubbed together to buy an investment property in Lowestoft in Suffolk.

Dion Dublin is in Walsall in the Midlands looking around a 1950s semi, Martin Roberts meets a man developing a ground-floor one-bedroom flat in Ilford in Essex, and Lucy Alexander catches up on a multimillion-pound redevelopment.

A house with a bathroom layout challenge in Ripley, Derbyshire, a huge three-storey house with its freehold on offer in Erdington, Birmingham, and a mid-terrace house in London's East Ham in need of a major makeover are all sold under the hammer.

Dion Dublin is in Lincolnshire looking round a pair of rural semi-detached cottages which the new owner may convert into one home. Martin Roberts is in Cheshire at a bungalow with bags of potential, and Lucy Alexander is in Kent talking to friends embarking on their first project together.

A house in Chesterton in Staffordshire has a smelly problem and needs a total overhaul. The new owner of a semi in Bestwood in Nottingham also has a lot to do, while the new owner of a flat in Strawberry Hill has less than a week to sort out her auction buy before she jets off to Germany.

A husband-and-wife duo add their design skills to a house in Croydon, while a seasoned developer creates a high-end house of multiple occupation in Coventry. Also, a first-time developer also does a great job with a house full of period features.

Martin Roberts meets one of two young brothers busy building a property portfolio in Bolsover, Derbyshire, while Dion Dublin checks out a three-bedroom semi in Wolverhampton, and Lucy Alexander is impressed by plans to convert a two-bedroom, fire-damaged terraced house in London's Plaistow into a smart five-bedroom property.

Dion Dublin has a hair-raising experience at a barber's in Rochdale, Lancashire, while Martin Roberts looks round a great bungalow in Alsager, Cheshire, and Lucy Alexander sees all the potential in a piece of land in Eccles in Kent.

Martin Roberts visits a house in Otterton, Devon, which is given a stunning transformation to match the views from the windows; Lucy Alexander looks round a small one-bedroom flat in Tottenham, London; and Dion Dublin peers into a building in Alvaston, Derby, which is in a dangerous state of disrepair.

Lucy Alexander is in Welling in the London Borough of Bexley looking round a three-bed semi in need of lots of work, Dion Dublin is in Basford, Nottingham, where a three-bedroom terraced house also requires a major revamp, and Martin Roberts hears plans from a father-and-son team who plan to knock down their auction property in Callington, Cornwall, and start again.
Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin visit a one-bedroom flat in Catford, London, a large house near the River Mersey and a semi-detached property in Alvaston in Derby.

An end-terrace house in Alfreton in Derby bought by two brothers, a mid-terrace on the coast at Seaham in County Durham and a large three-storey property with a flat and shop in Taylorstown in the Rhondda Valley are all sold at auction. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin talk to the new owners to find out what they have planned for their auction buys.

Martin Roberts falls in love with a quirky cottage in Malvern bought by a builder and his wife, Dion Dublin talks to a first-time property developer who sees her end-terrace house in Chell in Stoke-on-Trent as something for her pension pot, and Lucy Alexander meets a divorced couple who have decided to form a new union as property developers doing up a shop and flat in Dover, Kent.

A large piece of land in Ratby in Leicestershire, a terrace in Chesterton in Staffordshire and a 1930s semi with a huge garden and huge potential are all sold at auction. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the developers hoping to breathe new life into their auction buys.

England continue their autumn campaign in the Nations Championship with a massive test of their credentials against New Zealand at the Allianz Stadium. The two sides last met a year ago when England were in irresistible form as they surged to a 33-19 victory. After a poor 🏉 [Rugby] Six Nations, another win against Dave Rennie's new look All Blacks would be massive confidence boost for Steve Borthwick and his charges. Mark Pougatch is joined by Ugo Monye, Sean Fitzpatrick and Danny Care for [LIVE] coverage.
pr.sub: Northern Series: England v New Zealand

pr.d: Ireland continue their autumn campaign in the Nations Championship with a crunch match against the World Champions South Africa in Dublin. The two sides last met a year ago when the Springboks produced a scrummaging masterclass to earn a first win at the Aviva Stadium in thirteen years. Andy Farrell has admitted his Irish side are a work in progress and will need his experienced men like Tadhg Furlong, Andrew Porter and Jamison Gibson-Park to stand up and be counted.

pr.d: Was früher mit viel Zeit und Aufwand verbunden war, wird heutzutage massenweise und in kürzester Zeit hergestellt: das moderne Fertighaus. The world comes alive in a different way after sunset, with bright city lights or the glow of a 24-hour industrial complex. See how the scenery changes through the night with time-lapse photography.

pr.t: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
pr.d: Tokyo Skytree, one of Japan's most famous tourist attractions, is equipped with many countermeasures against disasters. We'll explore the tower's advanced technologies.

Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.

When Captain Squid leaves his treasure map in the Little Kingdom, Redbeard the Elf Pirate leads Ben, Holly and Nanny Plum on a treasure hunt.
The Kangaroos take Peppa and her family to the beach on their second day in Australia where they try surfing for the first time.

Sadly, Peppa and her family's holiday in Australia is coming to an end, but they still have time to play with a boomerang and make friends with Mr Wallaby.

Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their favourite nursery rhymes. From singing Little Bo Peep to marching along with The Grand Old Duke of York, everyone enjoys listening to each other's choice.
