Tim, Tia and Tommy try to convince Mum and Dad to let them have a pet.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim and Kai go crater surfing and attempt a cool new trick.
Paddington and Simi go on a magical journey into the human body.
pr.sub: Paddington's Goo Monster; Paddington's Apple Pip Adventure

pr.d: Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
pr.sub: Mr Bull Digs Up the River

pr.d: Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when they learn that Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are getting married the next day; everyone goes into a panic when they confess how they have done nothing to prepare for the big day.

Everyone prepares for Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow's wedding; Peppa and the soon-to-be-weds go to the jewellers to get rings, to the dressmakers, to get a wedding dress and finally to Peppa's house to sort the wedding cake.
Holly spends the day with King Thistle on his royal duties. King Thistle must launch an elf boat, judge a fairy fruit competition and make a speech at the festival.
The children are at the Elf Farm, but to learn where milk comes from they must visit a big farm, to find cows. The children travel to Lucy Big's farm, where she shows them all the animals.
Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but they prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.
Peppa and her friends are in a playgroup and Mr Bull is building a wind turbine. Madame Gazelle explains everything to the children about wind energy.
Mummy Pig suggests the family all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then unexpectedly bump into Mrs Crocodile. Later on, Mr Lion invites them to have a picnic.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language, and Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Peppa, her friends, and their parents, learn woodworking from Mister Wolf. He asks Daddy Pig to make a hut out of twigs, but it isn't very strong, and Mister Wolf manages to blow it down.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea and gives them tips on how to stay safe.
Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero party and Super Potato is one of the guests. Together, they play some party games and Super Potato gets to show everyone his superpowers.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Peppa and her friends are playing in their clubhouse, which has a fold-down counter at the front. The children pretend to run a little shop for the parents to buy things from.

Peppa and her friends come to school early to have breakfast together. They learn about how food gives you energy and talk about their favourite breakfast foods. They all end up having toast with fun toppings. Finally, they have a good stretch and dance to get ready for the day and all sing the breakfast song.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit is teaching the children a swimming lesson, They start out by swimming with floats tucked under their arms.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup and today Madame Gazelle would like them all to play music. They think they are playing with normal instruments, but today the children must make their own instruments. Madame Gazelle gathers bits and bobs of old packaging and shows them how to make their own. At the end of the day, they put on a special concert for the parents.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful mini-golf course next door.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.

It is raining, and Grandpa Rabbit has built a rocket pack. As he demonstrates it to Peppa and George, he inadvertently ends up atop a snowy mountain. Miss Hare attempts to rescue him but becomes stranded on the mountaintop as well.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.
When Daddy Pig is given a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules just like children - and that they get told off too.
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.
Granny and Grandpa's pet Polly Parrot comes to stay, and Peppa and George love Polly Parrot. But when she flies away, no one knows what to do.
Grandpa Pig has built a fantastic little train called Gertrude, and when they take a ride, they give all their friends a ride.
When Peppa goes for a sleepover at Zoe Zebra's house with Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant, the girls are too excited to go to sleep.
It's nighttime at Grandpa and Granny Pig's house, and Peppa and George have stayed up late to help hunt for slugs and snails. But what other night animals will they find?
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy and Daddy Pig.
When Daddy Pig loses his glasses he gets a bit grumpy, but Peppa and George have lots of fun looking for them.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets.
Peppa and family go on a walk through the forest where they meet all of their favourite fairytale characters. They visit the home of bears who like porridge and meet a hungry Mr Wolf.
Peppa and all her friends at playgroup dress up as different countries from all over the world.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends, but one day they have a quarrel over a game of cards and decide they are not best friends any more.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog to rescue them.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.

Peppa and George go bird watching with Grandpa Pig. Peppa quacks like a duck, George coos like a pigeon, and they all have great fun filling in Grandpa Pig's book. Grandpa wants to see a cuckoo, and suddenly he hears one calling.
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.
George is being potty-trained and Mummy Pig is encouraging him to shout "potty" whenever he needs the toilet.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's motorbike tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it.
Peppa's Playgroup has a garden outside. The children are all having fun growing different plants and playing hide and seek in the wild wood.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and friends are at school where they have a special guest, Mr Potato. Together they sing the vegetable song about the importance of eating five fruits or vegetables a day. Mr Potato is there to host a special quiz about fruit and vegetables. They argue about a tomato being a vegetable and have to call up a very clever friend to help. Two groups of children compete to find out who knows the most.
pr.sub: Mr. Potato's Fruit and Vegetable Quiz

pr.d: Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
pr.sub: Mr Bull Digs Up the River

pr.d: Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. They see Grampy Rabbit and his pet newt. Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit about how she wishes she could exercise more but doesn't have any room. Grampy Rabbit decides to build something special to help Dr Hamster exercise more.
Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up.
Peppa and family go camping, but soon realise that their tent is too small for everyone, so Daddy sleeps underneath the stars.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules.
Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club where they go on secret missions, and do secret things, but soon everyone wants to join.
Doctor Hamster is rushed off her feet when nearly all the animals need her help on the same day.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
When a power cut plunges their house into darkness, Peppa and George have fun looking for a torch and thinking of games to play in the dark.
Peppa and George visit Mr Fox's Shop to buy Granny and Grandpa an anniversary present, but have trouble choosing from the shop that sells everything.
Peppa's friends are all riding their bicycles. Peppa is determined to learn to cycle without her stabilisers after she teases George about having a baby's tricycle.
It's raining, and Peppa is sad because she cannot play outside. However, when the rain stops, Peppa and George get to play one of their favourite games, namely jumping in muddy puddles.
When the police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
Peppa and her family travel to Paris to visit Delphine and her relatives. The donkeys take Peppa and her family to the top of the Eiffel Tower, forcing Dad to face his fear of heights.
Peppa and George are taken to visit the home that Mr Bull is building. They could also find out who their new neighbours are going to be.
Peppa's car runs out of petrol, but Granddad Dog's garage is nearby, and with one call, Granddad Dog is on his way to help.
Peppa and her family follow a nature trail in the countryside, discovering footprints left by little birds and ants.
Miss Rabbit is to be given the Queen's Award for Industry for all the hard work she does, and Peppa and her friends will accompany her to the palace to meet the Queen.
Peppa and her friends are on Snowy Mountain learning how to ski. Their teacher, Madame Gazelle, is very good and was once a world champion, but in the end it is Mummy Pig who impresses everyone.
Peppa and George have a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa dresses as a fairy princess and George as a scary dinosaur.
Peppa and George are playing hide and seek, but Peppa complains that George is too easy to find.
Peppa tries to learn how to whistle after she realises that seemingly everyone but her can do it.
Peppa and George go to play with Cousin Chloe and her friends, but the older children don't want to play any baby games.
Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George. George and Richard each have a toy dinosaur, but the boys are not very good at sharing their toys.
Peppa loves cycling downhill, but is not so keen on pedalling uphill, so she insists everyone have a downhill race.
Mummy Dog and Danny are very excited. Captain Daddy Dog is home from the sea, and he's bearing gifts. What can they be?

Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout at Peppa's playground that uses spinning hoops. Though they have fun playing with the hoops, they have a hard time spinning them around their waists as directed.
Miss Rabbit persuades Mummy Pig to go to her relaxation class, but relaxing proves more difficult than expected. However, thanks to Daddy Pig's bouncy castle, they all have fun in the end.
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.
Daddy Piggy arrives in an electric car. The family go out and are surprised when the car talks.
Granny and her friends' historical re-enactment society are being cave people today. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a woolly mammoth.

Rebecca and Richard Rabbit are playing a marble run game at Peppa's house. But when Daddy Pig joins in and improvises tunnels and bridges, the marble rolls out of the bedroom, causing chaos and nearly knocking Goldie out of her bowl.
Peppa and family are watching TV, until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything, but it doesn't beat their old TV.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's while Granny hosts a re-enactment of the 1960s with her friends.
While Mum makes an apple pie, Dad suggests that Peppa and George play at finding hidden things. Peppa and George then start running around the house to solve the clues and find the objects.
Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play bat and ball, but when it is her turn, she hits the ball too far, and they must catch it before it hits the ground.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Mummy Pig is confirming she is having a new baby. Mummy and Daddy Pig share the exciting news with Peppa and her brother, George.
Peppa and her friends from playgroup visit a science museum, where they learn all sorts of things.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.

The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and Suzy are bored because they have nothing to do, so Daddy Pig finds them an old box of garden games to play with, but not all the games are easy for little George.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Peppa and her family go on a day trip to visit the Windy Castle. Mummy Pig drives, while Daddy Pig reads the map. When they reach the destination, Peppa and George spot Granny and Grandpa Pig's house.
Peppa's family go to the museum's moon exhibition with George's friend, Edmond Elephant.
Miss Rabbit has hurt her ankle, so her sister and her friends offer to fill in for her at the ice cream stand, the supermarket, and everywhere else she works.
Pedro Pony pretends he is a proper cowboy, telling everyone stories in the camp he has set up in the garden.
It's Wendy Wolf's birthday, and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party. There are bubbles and balloons to play with, and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf.
Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig's boat and head out for a day on the river. All is going well until the boat gets stuck in some long reeds. Daddy Pig to the rescue.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket, and George sits in the trolley while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list.

It's Peppa Pig's birthday so she awakens very early. First, Peppa gets a present from Mummy, Daddy and George, and then it's time for her party. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks and makes a birthday cake appear with four candles for Peppa to blow out.
Peppa's family gets caught in a very long traffic jam whilst on the way to have lunch with Granny and Grandpa Pig.
Peppa and the rest of the playgroup put on a big Christmas show for all the parents. While Danny Dog is dressed up as a Santa, the real Father Christmas pays them a visit.
Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island.
pr.sub: The Biggest Muddy Puddle in the World

pr.d: Before bed, Peppa and George have a bath, brush their teeth and listen to Daddy Pig read them a story. Finally, they're asleep and Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig can relax.
Peppa and George go to Rebecca Rabbit's house where, instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels.
Peppa and her family are playing at the pond with their toy boats, but when Peppa and George's friends arrive, everyone has a boat to play with except Rebecca Rabbit.
Daddy Pig is looking forward to taking Peppa and George to visit a fishpond that he used to visit when he was a piglet. However, a few things have changed since then.
Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive in the country, but the car is very muddy and Mummy insists they wash it first.
Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children soon catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill?
Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it is Freddy Fox with his super-smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building! With the help of Mr. Bull and his brother they find that instead of demolishing the vets they can build a tunnel underneath it.
Peppa and her family share a picnic with Mr Zebra the Postman and Zoe Zebra, but when it's time to go home, Peppa leaves her teddy behind.
Peppa and George are visiting their big cousin Chloe and will get to meet Chloe's new baby brother Alexander for the first time.

It's a very cold winter's day, and Peppa and George head to the park to play, but all the puddles have frozen over, so the two must think of other ways to entertain themselves.
George enjoys seeing his reflection in the mirror so much that he and Peppa try to find other shiny things to see themselves in.
Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never wants to take them off, until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.
Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.
Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her poultry. Elsewhere, something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse.
Daddy teaches Peppa and George a fun game to play while they wait inside for the rain to stop.
Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Mr Rabbit works with numbers, while Mrs Cat seems to spend her time drawing shapes on a computer.
Peppa and her friends go on a camping trip with their teacher, Madame Gazelle. After pitching their tents and collecting sticks, they all sing a song around the campfire.
A new student, Gerald the giraffe, joins the playgroup where Peppa and her friends go. However, when he tries to fit in, he finds it difficult to play hide-and-seek because he is so tall.
Peppa's family are at Digger World, where they have fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.
George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa is very frightened until she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her. She names him Mister Skinny legs.
Delphine the donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup, where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song'.
Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work, as well as Happy Mrs Chicken, but when it breaks they are not sure who will fix it.
Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.
Peppa and George go to the seaside with Granny and Grandpa Pig and realise not all beaches are sandy. This one has lots of rocks and little rock pools to explore.
The doctor teaches children what to do if there is ever an accident. A patient soon appears, and they put into practise the new techniques they have learned.
There's a spider in the house. Mummy Pig tells Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes.
Peppa's playgroup are really enjoying Grampy Rabbit's talk about space rockets, until suddenly he loses his voice. Doctor Brown Bear must get him speaking again.

Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson, and meets her friends Candy, Suzy, Rebecca, Danny and Pedro there. She decides to teach Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig to dance but finds out they have some moves of their own.
George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.
The family have a special day planned for George's birthday. They visit the museum and see dinosaurs, before ending the day with cake.
Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper until everyone helps him train to win it back.
Madame Gazelle introduces a new pupil to the playgroup, Emily Elephant, and everyone wants to be her friend because she's very good at building blocks and can make a very loud noise with her trunk.

Thaddäus ernennt SpongeBob aus Faulheit zum Chef vom Dienst, was allerdings nur 15 Minuten währt, da dann bereits das Chaos ausgebrochen ist. Und: Sandy, Mr. Krabs und Patrick bitten SpongeBob um Gefallen, die er ihnen nicht abschlagen möchte.

During a heatwave, Will tries to fix the broken air conditioning to protect his family. Ellie's bossy behaviour at Raven Club makes Jack and Lil quit, forcing her to save her friendships and her investigation.
pr.sub: Where There's a Will, There's a Way; Lost in the Sauce

pr.d: Mr. Krabs stellt Patrick in der Krossen Krabbe ein, um die Kunden zu belustigen. Er spielt den umfallenden Idioten. SpongeBob und Patrick finden einen Spielzeugladen so toll, dass sie sich über Nacht dort einschließen lassen.
pr.sub: Der hutlose Patrick; Spielzeuggeschäft des Grauens

pr.d: When Lily begins digging to discover why her favourite ice cream van is selling shaved ice, she uncovers a town-wide conspiracy. Dirk is wrongly accused of stealing a Canyon Valley landmark, so Min comes out of retirement as a lawyer to help him.
pr.sub: Follow the Sprinkles; Canyon Valley V Dirk

pr.d: Was als Freundschaftsausflug auf den Strand beginnt, endet für SpongeBob und Patrick in einem heftigen Wettbewerb im Bauen von Sandburgen. SpongeBob zerbricht Garys Schneckenhaus und versucht für Ersatz zu sorgen, doch er ist zu tollpatschig.
pr.sub: Sandburgen im Sand; Gary allein ohne Haus

pr.d: When Alvin is paired with Simon to work on a science project, he accidentally creates a potion that turns Theodore into a giant. When all the children's phones go missing at school, Alvin is blamed for the theft and sets out to clear his name.

Planktons Frau Karen rät ihm, dass er mehr Werbung für den "Abfalleimer" machen soll. Aber den Durchbruch erlebt Plankton erst mit einem Werbeslogan, der ausgerechnet von Patrick stammt. Und: Plankton vergisst seinen Hochzeitstag mit Karen.

Desperate to avenge last year's humiliating loss, the chipmunks argue over who is best suited to lead them to victory; Alvin grows tired of seeing his celebrity status overshadowed by reality TV stars, so he decides to become one himself.

Mr. Krabs will mehr Geld in die Kasse spülen und feiert deshalb den Geburtstag der Krossen Krabbe, bei der viele Pasteten verkauft werden sollen. Allerdings sperren sich Thaddäus, Patrick, SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs versehentlich in der Kühltruhe ein.
Max and Phoebe advance to the final tryout for a place on an elite superhero squad, but a new villain with a surprise connection to the family may force them to give up their crime fighting dream.

Auf der Geburtstagsfeier von Krosse Krabbe schließen sich SpongeBob und seine Freunde aus Versehen in einer Kühltruhe ein und versuchen nun, wieder freizukommen. Derweil macht sich Plankton auf, um das Pasteten-Rezept zu finden.
Max and Phoebe advance to the final tryout for a place on an elite superhero squad, but a new villain with a surprise connection to the family may force them to give up their crime fighting dream.

Thaddäus ist wegen eines Sturms mit SpongeBob und Patrick im Haus eingeschlossen. Plankton entdeckt per Zufall eine Unterwasser-Höhle. Er macht daraus ein Ausflugsziel und hört die Kassen klingeln, was Mr. Krabs nicht auf sich sitzen lassen kann.
Henry has a shapeshifting android fill in at a family dinner so that he can watch an 🥊 [MMA] MMA fight with Charlotte and Ray.

König Neptuns 5000. Geburtstag steht an und seine Frau plant in der Krossen Krabbe eine Party für ihn. Doch als alle nett beisammen sind, taucht der verbannte Sohn der beiden, Triton, auf. SpongeBob will die drei wieder vereinen.
When Ray starts behaving strangely, Henry and Charlotte investigate and are surprised to discover the cause of his behaviour.

Thaddäus Lieblingssendung wurde abgesetzt, und er beschließt, selbst eine Sendung zu drehen und SpongeBob wird beim Tanzen zufällig von einer Agentin entdeckt. Thaddäus ist neidisch auf SpongeBobs Erfolg und versucht, dessen Casting zu sabotieren.
On her quest to get her own Marsupilami, Bibi encounters a jaguar which scares her enough to give up the hunt. Marcel gets a job as the school chef after Jade causes the usual employee to quit.

Thaddäus und Blubber-Bass müssen sich auf einer Reise nach Muschelhausen gegenseitig ertragen. Thaddäus macht eine Reise in die Fantasiebox und muss sich auf die Kreativität von SpongeBob und Patrick verlassen, um zu entkommen.

Plankton entdeckt das geheime Ersatzrezept für den Krabbenburger im Eimer. Er versucht den Eimer zu stehlen. Zudem entwickelt SpongeBob nach einem Unfall einen unkontrollierbaren Lachanfall, was alle im Krossen Krabben zur Verzweiflung treibt.

SpongeBobs Quallenfischernetz ist verschwunden, und er verdächtigt Patrick des Diebstahls. Weil der echte Thaddäus nicht mit SpongeBob spielen will, bastelt er sich einfach selbst einen kleinen Thaddäus und spielt mit der Handpuppe.
Blossom brings Scaredy on a trip to the forest to conquer his fear.

Gargamel confiscates Dwayne and Rowena's toys; in revenge, they free the Smurfs their uncle had captured; jealous of DD's abilities, Handy builds himself supercharged exoskeleton, which malfunctions and DD is the only one who can save him.

SpongeBob hat beschlossen, ab jetzt nur noch unter Quallen fernab der Zivilisation zu leben. Seine Freunde versuchen, ihn zur Umkehr zu bewegen, aber der kleine Schwamm bleibt bei seiner Entscheidung. Doch dann zeigen die Quallen ihr wahres Gesicht.
The whole village admires Painter's new style of painting, without realising that the artist is actually Baby Smurf.

SpongeBob freut sich auf einen Tag mit Burger braten und Quallenfischen, aber alles geht schief. Ein Missgeschick nach dem nächsten passiert. Patrick macht SpongeBob ein ganz besonderes Geschenk: sein Gummiteil - ein Ball aus Kaugummi.

Smurfstorm unknowingly leads Smurflily and Smurfblossom into a trap when she enlists their help to drive Gargamel out of the forest forever; Hefty Smurf unwittingly changes bodies with Baby Smurf when Smurfstorm challenges him.

Mr. Krabs und Plankton waren als Jugendliche unzertrennlich, haben sich dann aber um ein Bulettenrezept zerstritten. Allerdings erzählen sie beide ziemlich unterschiedliche Versionen von diesem Streit. Welche Geschichte stimmt?
The Chipmunks don't want to perform in the school play, after learning of its curse; Simon's robot Gizmo becomes jealous of Jeanette's robot Zeela, until a sudden tragedy reveals Gizmo's true heart.
pr.sub: The Curse of Macbeth; Zeela the Great

pr.d: SpongeBob lernt Jim kennen, den allerersten Burgerbrater der Krossen Krabbe, der sehr beliebt war. Außerdem schmecken seine Burger noch besser als die von SpongeBob. SpongeBob hat Angst vor der Dunkelheit und macht die Nacht zum Tage.

In an effort to be more productive, Simon invents a device that can override the need to sleep; Alvin gets a taste of his own medicine when he zaps Dave with a youth ray, turning him into an irresponsible teen.

SpongeBob will herausfinden, was sein Freund morgens macht. SpongeBob hat viel Müsli gegessen, um die Deckel zu sammeln und ein Spielzeug umsonst zu bekommen. Außerdem hat er einen Hautausschlag, der ganz schlimm juckt. Er ist ansteckend.

Paper and Scissors struggle to make Rock's outlandish half-birthday wish that he can fly come true. Scissors stays home when Rock and Paper go cherry-picking, but when they grow much closer to one another, he feels left out.

SpongeBob und Patrick sollen für Mr. Krabs dessen Erzfeind Plankton ausspionieren. Thaddäus und SpongeBob sollen in einem Film zeigen, wie die Wasserverkehr-Regeln funktionieren. Mr. Krabs hat eine neue Idee, um mehr Kunden zu bekommen.
pr.sub: Spionagekumpel / Boots-Weisheiten / Was geht Sie das an?

pr.d: Patrick und SpongeBob legen ein Tunnelsystem unter Bikini Bottom an, weil sie nicht mehr auf das Grundstück von Thaddäus dürfen. Patrick entpuppt sich dabei als enormes Karatetalent, doch leider kann er sein neues Können nicht im Zaum halten.

Paper and Pencil inadvertently create a horde of Rock clones and decide to look after them together. Rock, Paper, and Scissors find a genie, but just as they're about to make their wish, his 1,000-year curse runs out, and he can no longer grant it.
pr.sub: Rock, Rock, Rock, Rock, Rock, Paper, Scissors; The Wish

pr.d: Blaze und sein Freund AJ fahren bei einem Monstertruckwettrennen mit und werden von einem Konkurrenten ausgetrickst. Der gemeine Crusher will unbedingt gewinnen und benutzt einen Seifenblasenstab, um die anderen wegfliegen zu lassen.

When Lily begins digging to discover why her favourite ice cream van is selling shaved ice, she uncovers a town-wide conspiracy. Dirk is wrongly accused of stealing a Canyon Valley landmark, so Min comes out of retirement as a lawyer to help him.
pr.sub: Follow the Sprinkles; Canyon Valley V Dirk

pr.d: Der junge SpongeBob möchte seine erste Qualle fangen und erhält dabei Hilfe von seinen Freunden.

The family is excited to take Jack to Lake World, Lily's favourite theme park. However, after a disappointing day, they discover Lily's favourite ride has vanished. The children must embark on a thrilling adventure to find it and save their holiday.
Als Patricks Zeit Kleiderschrank den Geist aufgibt, wird SpongeBobs Vergangenheit von zeitreisenden Eindringlingen umgeschrieben.
When Alvin talks Dave into buying a used tour bus, Dave has no idea of the problems ahead. Alvin signs the Chipmunks up for a game show that forces losing contestants to perform dangerous stunts.
Thaddäus verbringt einen Tag im Waschsalon. SpongeBob und Patrick suchen ein Wurmschwein.

When Derek overhears that Alvin and his brothers are alone for the weekend, he plans a wild party at their house. Theodore is hit by lightning and believes he's like his comic book hero, until he's told he's actually a villain.
pr.sub: Animal House Party; Dr. Zap vs. Electroboy

pr.d: Der Tierpflegesalon wird überraschend inspiziert. Das kaputte Rohr, um das sich Jack und Lily nicht gekümmert haben, könnte alles ruinieren. Chuck hat ein neues Unterfangen: ein Theatercamp. Jack und Lily wittern Betrug, doch es steckt mehr dahinter.
pr.sub: Nur ein kleines Rohrproblem / Camp Chuck

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: To increase baby love, Baby Boss schemes to change the local soccer team's name from the Hive to the Babies.

Jack und Lily erhalten von Will und Min Hausarrest, doch die Situation ändert sich, als die beiden Aufpasser selbst von Halmoni bestraft werden. Währenddessen leidet Jack beim Filmfestival in Canyon Valley unter großer Anspannung.
pr.sub: Der Ausbruch / Das Canyon Valley Filmfestival

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: After sneaking into a grown-up movie, Tim decides he's ready for the adult world; Boss Baby sleeps over at a friend's house.

Schere, Stein und Papier wollen beweisen, dass sie besser sind als ein weiteres gleichnamiges Trio. Stein und Papiere versuchen gemeinsam, einen Streit zwischen Schere und einer Magierin zu schlichten, bevor die Magie ihr Leben zerstört.

Papier befürchtet, dass Bleistift zu viel Angst haben wird, wenn sie einen Horrorfilm anschauen. Stein und Schere müssen Papier schnell helfen, denn ein leichter Wind weht und Papier ist noch auf der Straße. Die beiden müssen ihn retten.
pr.sub: Besuch von Bleistift / Eine leichte Brise

pr.d: Upset by Phoebe's secret partnership with Captain Perfect, Max decides to find a new superhero partner in his best friend, Gideon. However, things go awry when Max attempts to mould Gideon into a better superhero.

Lincoln muss seine zehn Schwestern vom Fernseher fernhalten, damit er seine Lieblingssendung gucken kann. Lincoln hinterlässt für Lori eine böse Nachricht, was ihm sofort leid tut, als es bereits passiert ist. Er will die Nachricht unbemerkt löschen.
pr.sub: Allein im Dunkeln; Nachricht für dich

pr.d: Captain Perfect's younger sister, Penny, is veering towards a life of supervillain. Keen to impress Captain Perfect, Max takes it upon himself to guide her onto a better path.

Lincoln wird in der Schule von einem Rowdy gehänselt, was ihm sehr peinlich ist. Er will diesen Umstand vor seinen Schwestern verheimlichen. Lincoln will endlich eine Trophäe gewinnen. In seinem Eifer übertreibt er sein Vorhaben etwas.
We interview Lauren Steadman and head to the NFL London Game at Wembley Stadium to set the fans a challenge.

Lincoln versucht, Leni das Autofahren beizubringen. Allerdings stellt sich das als schwieriger als zunächst angenommen heraus. Lincoln passt es nicht, dass Lori als Babysitterin so streng ist. Er will das Kommando übernehmen - mit Überraschungen.
Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried about Alvin's safety after Alvin enters a karate contest.
Cecil and his friends go on a fishing trip at the lake; in a post-apocalyptic future, Bunny competes in a Roller Derby match to save the world.

Lincoln möchte beim Familienausflug den besten Platz im Auto ergattern. Das sehen seine Schwestern allerdings anders. Lincoln will nicht mehr am Kindertisch sitzen. Er will seine Reife beweisen, um am Erwachsenentisch sitzen zu dürfen.
pr.sub: Der Premiumplatz; Die Geschichte der zwei Tische

pr.d: Lincoln hört ein Gespräch seiner Eltern und befürchtet, dass diese ihn loswerden wollen.
Squidina and SpongeBob shoot advertisements to fund the Patrick Show. GrandPat takes over Death's job for a day.

SpongeBob wird von einer Agentin zu einem Vortanzen eingeladen, weil er viel Talent hat. Thaddäus ist eifersüchtig, denn er ist auch ehrgeizig, was das Tanzen betrifft. Er trainiert hart, um den begnadeten SpongeBob zu übertrumpfen.
SpongeBob will Künstler werden und belegt einen Kunstkurs, der von Thaddäus unterrichtet wird.
Alvin's too short to ride a new amusement park ride; while on a ski trip, Alvin convinces Theodore there's a Yeti nearby.

1. Geschichte: Plankton erschafft einen Klon aus sich und Mr. Krabs. Doch dann kommt ein neuer Restaurantbesitzer. 2. Geschichte: Thaddäus tauscht seinen Job mit einem Busfahrer. Die Arbeit ist entspannt, bis SpongeBob und Patrick einsteigen.
pr.sub: Der Krosse Eimer; Thaddäus als Busfahrer

pr.d: When the girls at school develop a crush on the fire marshal, Alvin decides to be a hero with disastrous results; after causing an accident at a historic castle, Cheesy and Alvin work as reenactors to pay for the damage.

Thaddäus nimmt am Tanzwettbewerb teil und möchte diesen unter allen Umständen gewinnen. Er kann sich schon mit dem Siegerpokal sehen. Doch die Jury ist unbarmherzig und er leidet unter schlimmen Krämpfen, die er nicht loswird.

Die Kunden der Krossen Krabbe wandern ab zur Konkurrenz. Dort fungiert eine Statue des Eigentümers als Kletterfels für Kinder. Mr. Krabs möchte sich daraufhin auch in Stein meißeln lassen und engagiert dafür Thaddäus. Doch sie teilen keine Vision.

Paper pretends to be an expert on cavemen athletics because no one could've possibly studied it before - only to meet an expert. Lou's cat, Meatball, is very sick, and he asks the trio to save him, so they help turn Lou's cat into a vampire.

1. Geschichte: Als SpongeBob freiwillig auf die drei Nichten von Sandy aufpasst, wächst ihm die ganze Sache über den Kopf. 2. Geschichte: SpongeBob und Patrick arbeiten als Museumswächter. Doch dann versucht Thaddäus unbemerkt sein Gemälde dort aufzuhängen.
No description available · EPGTalk.com

Scissors meets his perfect romantic match, but she's a mermaid and he can't tell anyone about her. Rock accidentally shrinks Franz and himself while Paper and Scissors host a party to apologise to everyone they've wronged.
VMA-winner Alex Warren hosts the slime event of the year, where we celebrate your favourite stars from film, television, music, sports and social media.

Der frühere Freund Shoot, eine Bambussprosse, kehrt zurück. Doch die drei Freunde wollen nicht mehr mit ihm befreundet sein. Stein hat seinen ersten Arbeitstag bei Franz Roll. Der zeigt sich sehr exzentrisch und äußerst anspruchsvoll.

Papier glaubt, er sei an einer Elite-Uni angenommen worden. Dann merkt er, dass er nur in der dritten Klasse gelandet ist, die jedoch überraschend schwer ist. Schere bringt Lou dazu zu kündigen. Daraufhin übernimmt Catalina und ruiniert sein Leben.
pr.sub: Papier besucht eine Eliteschule / Die neue Vermieterin

pr.d: Mrs Wong visits Secret Shores, threatening to reveal the Thundermans' superhero identities to the town. Max and Phoebe's plan to have Dr Colosso keep her quiet backfires in unexpected ways.
Cecil zeigt seine Sammlung von Schnurrbärten und die Familie Star bringt eine Alraunwurzel heim.
Max convinces Cherry to pretend they are dating to get discounts at her new workplace, Splat by Sea. Meanwhile, Chloe must choose between winning a quiz or supporting Billy's wish to join her team.

Pinky glaubt, dass seine Mitschüler Babs, JJ und ihn als Clique wahrnehmen, und lädt sie fortan zu allem ein. Pinky ist begeistert, wie nett die Leute sind, wenn sie denken, dass er verletzt ist. Er beschließt, die Lüge aufrechtzuerhalten.
We interview Lauren Steadman and head to the NFL London Game at Wembley Stadium to set the fans a challenge.

Weil sein Bruder Lance über dem Restaurant ein Fitnessstudio aufbauen will, wird es für Dad schwierig, die Tafel von Lynn zu managen. Lola wird über alle Geschehnisse in der Schule informiert und soll daher eine Klatschkolumne starten.
pr.sub: Fitness mit Turbo-Lance / Viel Klatsch um nichts

pr.d: Coach Dobkins challenges Miss Smith and her ragtag team of outcasts to a baseball game to see who's the best.

Verkleidet als die intergalaktische Crew aus ihrem Lieblingsfilm machen sich Lincoln und seine Freunde auf den Weg zum Sammeln von Süßigkeiten. Doch der Abend nimmt eine unheimliche Wendung, als Menschen plötzlich verschwinden.

In an attempt to get out of the dentist, Lily insists on a summer celebration of the fall holiday Chuseok. When Will accidentally befriends an annoying man, his sorry attempts at a break-up make things painfully awkward for the whole family.
pr.sub: Summer Chuseok; Putting up With the Plovers

pr.d: Verkleidet als die intergalaktische Crew aus ihrem Lieblingsfilm machen sich Lincoln und seine Freunde auf den Weg zum Sammeln von Süßigkeiten. Doch der Abend nimmt eine unheimliche Wendung, als Menschen plötzlich verschwinden.

Min tries to avoid the usual Woori World chaos, but when the family splits up they all get lost in their own fiascos. Jack's mission to find the rare DVD sequel of his favourite movie leads him to the mysterious Collector.
pr.sub: The Real Woori World; The Collector

pr.d: Damit Plankton die Geheimformel von Mr. Krabs stehlen kann, stellt er einen Praktikanten ein, der viel über ihn weiß. Patrick hat ein Problem: Er verliert die Kontrolle, wenn er eine Glocke hört. Seine Freunde versuchen ihm auf ihre Art zu helfen.

Theo's funky art project becomes a star with its own social media fans, which is great until the page is hacked; Dave writes a hit love song from a poem he found, but since Simon wrote the poem, he panics his secret will come out.

SpongeBob und Thaddäus sollen Blubberbernd zum Zahlen seiner Rechnungen überzeugen. Mr. Krabs möchte Mrs. Puff für sich gewinnen und beauftragt SpongeBob und Thaddäus ihm zu helfen. Diese sollen ihm etwas kochen, doch sie können sich nicht einigen.

Stuck at home during a storm, Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly spirals out of control. Cheesy convinces Theodore and Alvin to help him steal the canteen's desserts through a secret network of underground tunnels.
Weil Patrick in der Handschuhwelt einen Roboter beschädigt, kommen er und SpongeBob ins Gefängnis. Es kommt zu einer chaotischen Flucht.
When Jade and Sam become friends, Cat feels left out and turns the tables by befriending an old friend of Sam's. Watch out for some guest stars!
Patrick steht unter dem Eindruck, ein alter Mann zu sein. Also muss SpongeBob ihn aufwecken.
When Jade and Sam become friends, Cat feels left out and turns the tables by befriending an old friend of Sam's. Watch out for big guest stars!
Trish's college sorority is reuniting for a mother-daughter step contest, and Lay Lay agrees to take over for Sadie, who is locked in a battle with Marky over their personal space.

Marky's favourite social media influencer, Beastie Pie, is hosting a gross food-eating competition at BoomBox Burger; when Sadie and Lay Lay overhear Beastie's plans to rig the contest, they work together to convince Marky that Beastie is a fraud.
When Hank raises the stakes of family game night to a new high, each member of the family will do whatever it takes to win the grand prize.
Jasper's summer camp girlfriend comes to town and stays with Charlotte. She quickly becomes jealous, thinking Charlotte is in love with Jasper.
With the return of Dr Minyak, Henry finds himself in danger when he realises that the evildoer has transformed his best friend, Charlotte, into an enemy.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: The Boss Baby declares war on a popular TV show starring a pygmy goat, a tamandua and their human handler.

pr.d: Boss Baby throws a cupcake party to combat low company morale, then sends a manager to help Tim handle some family business.

Cecil and his friends go on a fishing trip at the lake; in a post-apocalyptic future, Bunny competes in a Roller Derby match to save the world.
Squidina and SpongeBob shoot advertisements to fund the Patrick Show. GrandPat takes over Death's job for a day.
Alvin's too short to ride a new amusement park ride; while on a ski trip, Alvin convinces Theodore there's a Yeti nearby.

When the girls at school develop a crush on the fire marshal, Alvin decides to be a hero with disastrous results; after causing an accident at a historic castle, Cheesy and Alvin work as reenactors to pay for the damage.

Paper pretends to be an expert on cavemen athletics because no one could've possibly studied it before - only to meet an expert. Lou's cat, Meatball, is very sick, and he asks the trio to save him, so they help turn Lou's cat into a vampire.

Scissors meets his perfect romantic match, but she's a mermaid and he can't tell anyone about her. Rock accidentally shrinks Franz and himself while Paper and Scissors host a party to apologise to everyone they've wronged.
VMA-winner Alex Warren hosts the slime event of the year, where we celebrate your favourite stars from film, television, music, sports and social media.
Mrs Wong visits Secret Shores, threatening to reveal the Thundermans' superhero identities to the town. Max and Phoebe's plan to have Dr Colosso keep her quiet backfires in unexpected ways.
Max convinces Cherry to pretend they are dating to get discounts at her new workplace, Splat by Sea. Meanwhile, Chloe must choose between winning a quiz or supporting Billy's wish to join her team.
We interview Lauren Steadman and head to the NFL London Game at Wembley Stadium to set the fans a challenge.
Coach Dobkins challenges Miss Smith and her ragtag team of outcasts to a baseball game to see who's the best.

In an attempt to get out of the dentist, Lily insists on a summer celebration of the fall holiday Chuseok. When Will accidentally befriends an annoying man, his sorry attempts at a break-up make things painfully awkward for the whole family.
pr.sub: Summer Chuseok; Putting up With the Plovers

pr.d: Min tries to avoid the usual Woori World chaos, but when the family splits up they all get lost in their own fiascos. Jack's mission to find the rare DVD sequel of his favourite movie leads him to the mysterious Collector.
pr.sub: The Real Woori World; The Collector

pr.d: Theo's funky art project becomes a star with its own social media fans, which is great until the page is hacked; Dave writes a hit love song from a poem he found, but since Simon wrote the poem, he panics his secret will come out.

Stuck at home during a storm, Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly spirals out of control. Cheesy convinces Theodore and Alvin to help him steal the canteen's desserts through a secret network of underground tunnels.
When Jade and Sam become friends, Cat feels left out and turns the tables by befriending an old friend of Sam's. Watch out for some guest stars!
When Jade and Sam become friends, Cat feels left out and turns the tables by befriending an old friend of Sam's. Watch out for big guest stars!
Trish's college sorority is reuniting for a mother-daughter step contest, and Lay Lay agrees to take over for Sadie, who is locked in a battle with Marky over their personal space.

Marky's favourite social media influencer, Beastie Pie, is hosting a gross food-eating competition at BoomBox Burger; when Sadie and Lay Lay overhear Beastie's plans to rig the contest, they work together to convince Marky that Beastie is a fraud.
When Hank raises the stakes of family game night to a new high, each member of the family will do whatever it takes to win the grand prize.
Jasper's summer camp girlfriend comes to town and stays with Charlotte. She quickly becomes jealous, thinking Charlotte is in love with Jasper.
With the return of Dr Minyak, Henry finds himself in danger when he realises that the evildoer has transformed his best friend, Charlotte, into an enemy.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: The Boss Baby declares war on a popular TV show starring a pygmy goat, a tamandua and their human handler.
The biggest mystery 20,000 leagues beneath the sea is uncovered when SpongeBob and the gang find the lost city of Atlantis.
SpongeBob gets pumped up with the aid of inflatable muscles. Squidward's accidental pasting by a flying shell haunts SpongeBob and Patrick.
pr.sub: MuscleBob BuffPants; Squidward, the Unfriendly Ghost

pr.d: SpongeBob thinks a Krabby Patty has caused the health inspector to meet an early end. SpongeBob teaches Squidward about imagination.
pr.sub: The Nasty Patty; The Idiot Box

pr.d: After being covered in cement, the Bikini Bottomites are convinced that Squidward is an unknown species. SpongeBob tries out his new magic kit on Squidward.
While working at the Krusty Krab, SpongeBob accidentally gets a splinter. SpongeBob and Patrick are having fun with their new slide whistles, and, of course, it's driving Squidward.
SpongeBob and Patrick protest against the construction of a highway that would destroy Jellyfish Fields.
A young SpongeBob is determined to catch his first jellyfish, so his friends do whatever they can to help him.
The Roxie sisters go their separate ways; The Dinghy cabin kids discover life after dark.
Mr Krabs uses Sandy's experimental growth formula on a Krabby Patty with disastrous results. SpongeBob creates a buddy out of bubbles when none of his friends have time to play with him.
pr.sub: The Krabby Patty That Ate Bikini Bottom; Bubble Buddy Returns

pr.d: The 🏒 [NHL] Sharks are the toughest guys in town, but their next confrontation might be too much for SpongeBob to handle. Plankton clones SpongeBob in an effort to steal Krabs' secret formula, but the original Bob might ruin his plans.
SpongeBob and Patrick become trapped in an alternate dimension where anything they draw comes to life. SpongeBob and Patrick help Bubble Bass move out of his mother's basement.
It's standup comedy night at Kamp Koral, and the campers are ready to laugh until they scream. Patrick gets confused with a young Seasquatch while out in the woods.
SpongeBob, Sandy, and Patrick hike through the woods in search of a fabled nudist colony; SpongeBob helps Plankton at the Krusty Kanteen, leading to the development of a very familiar sandwich.
pr.sub: In Search of Camp Noodist; Kitchen Sponge

pr.d: In an alternate reality, Bikini Bottom is inhabited entirely by robots; Mr. Krabs installs a cursed payphone in the Krusty Krab; GrandPat travels through time to get home.
pr.sub: Welcome to Binary Bottom; You're Going to Pay... Phone; A Skin Wrinkle in Time

pr.d: The tiny futuristic city of Shmandor exacts revenge on Patrick Star. Patrick and Squidina go on location to interview their neighbours.
pr.sub: The Wrath of Shmandor; There Goes the Neighborhood

pr.d: Patrick hosts a safety training video. Patrick works at the mall.
Narlene and Nobby teach Regigille all about backwoods living; the Trawler cabin creates the perfect camper to compete in the Camp Summer Games.
It's the annual foam-fisted all-camp karate battle, and SpongeBob trains to beat the butt-kicking Sandy. It's the hottest day of summer, but there's only one AC in the whole camp.
pr.sub: Hill Fu; Sun's Out, Fun's Out

pr.d: After SpongeBob and Patrick eat an experiment, Plankton must counteract the monstrous side effects. Elsewhere, Mr Crab must find a babysitter for Pearl, but she proves to be demanding to care for.
Squidward takes a new job as manager of Weenie Hut Jr's. Squidward gets trapped on his way to return a nearly overdue library book.
pr.sub: Wiener Takes All / Stuck in an Elevator

pr.d: Cecil shows Patrick his moustache collection; the Star family brings a mandrake root into its home.
pr.sub: Dad's Stache Stash; A Root Galoot

pr.d: The stars are trapped in a sitcom; Patrick struggles without Squidina.
pr.sub: Sitcom Stars; The Show Must Go Yawn

pr.d: Squidward accidentally lets SpongeBob eat an exploding pie. Plankton schemes to steal the Krabby patty by disguising himself as Mr. Krabs.
Tinkle, Ouchie, and Pinkeye must venture back home together after being taken away by mistake; Patrick gets injured, so his family members take turns hosting the show.

SpongeBob and Squidward threaten Mr. Krabs with a strike, and Squidward tries to teach SpongeBob the power of picketing. A giant worm is terrorising Bikini Bottom and terrifying its residents, especially SpongeBob.
pr.sub: Squid on Strike; Sandy, SpongeBob and the Worm

pr.d: Mr Krabs' mum is dating again, and worse still, the object of her desires is Plankton. SpongeBob sets out to make his own Mermaid Man movie using the original actors, fresh from the retirement home.
pr.sub: Enemy In-Law; Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy VI

pr.d: Krabs puts Squidward in charge of all camp complaints. Patrick received a star on his birthday.
Plankton recruits Sandy to help in his lab. SpongeBob's new friend proves unpopular at camp.
pr.sub: Mad Science Squirrel; To Pop a Bubble

pr.d: Squidward is rushed to the hospital when SpongeBob accidentally slams the door on Squidward's face. A very windy day in Bikini Bottom is blowing air through SpongeBob's holes resulting in a chorus of pretty flute-like sounds.
pr.sub: The Two Faces of Squidward; Spongehenge

pr.d: Mr Krabs tries to find enough food to feed Pearl as she goes through her growth spurt. After showering, SpongeBob gets stuck in his wringer.
pr.sub: Growth Spout; Stuck in the Wringer

pr.d: In Hamdonia, Prince Shmeat and Tofu Todd embark on a quest to defeat the Maw. After learning what stage fright is, Patrick fears his own audience.
The Star family is a superhero team; Cecil works as a security guard at Lady Upturn's art museum.
pr.sub: Super Stars; Now Museum, Now You Don't

pr.d: Sandy only wanted to spend a relaxing holiday alone on the moon. But it seems she's got a stowaway aboard her rocket who doesn't share her idea. On his trip to the Ocean Mint, Mr Krabs learns that old money is shredded and burned.
pr.sub: Mooncation; Mr. Krabs Takes a Vacation

pr.d: Sandy tries to study SpongeBob and Patrick's behaviour, but her science experiment goes horribly awry. Mr. Krabs takes Plankton's advice, and finally marries the only thing he ever loved, money.
Counsellor Squidward is determined for his cabin to win the annual camp art competition. The Kamp Koral campers befriend a cute cow with a big appetite.
Patrick and Octo must survive together in the forest after Octo twists all of his ankles. The adults sneak off to play a board game, but one of the campers is not easily shaken off.
The Patricks battle for control of the TV; Upturn moves in with the Stars.
Patrick learns what GrandPat's childhood was like; Cave Pat hosts a show with his cave family.
pr.sub: The Lil' Patscals; The Pre-Historic Patrick Star Show

pr.d: SpongeBob embarks on an epic journey to have his beloved spatula reforged by the legendary Guru Greasetrap; SpongeBob builds a snail-house outside for Gary to play in while he is at work.
pr.sub: Spatula of the Heavens; Gary's Playhouse

pr.d: SpongeBob and Patrick make it their mission to reunite the recently fired robot band from Goofy Goober's; Patrick is sent to the pound for acting like a worm, but he won't be able to leave unless SpongeBob can train him.
After getting rid of Ouchie, Pinkeye takes over the Star house; Patrick and Squidina must find safety during the dad joke apocalypse.
pr.sub: Get Ouch; Day of the Living Dad Jokes

pr.d: Patrick and Squidina report the news around Bikini Bottom; "The Patrick Show!" presents the epic conclusion to the first half of its first season.
Patrick learns how to exercise. A family of dummies move into the Star home.
SpongeBob and Squidward are sent to collect unpaid bills. SpongeBob and Squidward cook a fancy meal for Mrs Puff.

When Patrick discovers the pineapple's library, SpongeBob introduces him to the wonderful world of book learning. Plankton hasn't tried to steal the secret formula in a while and that's making Mr Krabs nervous.
SpongeBob gets a pair of long pants, but they change his life in unexpected ways. When Larry the Lobster opens a new gym in Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob becomes his best customer.

SpongeBob and Patrick bet who can hold a funny face the longest, then their faces freeze that way. SpongeBob and Patrick spend one last glorious, and dangerous, day at Glove World before it closes for good.

Plankton has demolished the Chum Bucket and in its place, he has built a Roman coliseum. The Bikini Bottom Symphony is accepting submissions for their composition contest, and Squidward is determined to win.

After arriving one minute late for work, SpongeBob decides to move into the Krusty Krab so that he will never be late again. When Plankton secretly turns down the thermostat at the Krusty Krab, the entire restaurant freezes over.
pr.sub: New Digs; Krabs a la Mode

Liz gibt DCI Wheatley wichtige Informationen, verschweigt jedoch bestimmte Fakten, da sie befürchtet, sich selbst und ihre geheimen Ermittlungen zu der undichten Stelle zu gefährden.

In Folge 3 gerät die einzige überlebende Zeugin, die Tochter der ermordeten McLennans, in große Gefahr. Kaum jemand wusste, wo sie sich aufhält - Liz Nyles beginnt zu vermuten, dass es eine oder sogar mehrere undichte Stellen gibt.

In Folge 4 wird Liz Nyles mit dem problematischen neuen Zeugen Patrick Ellis konfrontiert, den sie gegen ihr Bauchgefühl in das Zeugenschutzprogramm aufnehmen soll. Das bringt sie in Kontakt mit dem stellvertretenden Polizeichef.
Liz wird immer klarer, dass sie machtvolle Feinde innerhalb der Polizei hat, die alles tun werden, um ihre eigenen Spuren zu verwischen und ihr alles in die Schuhe zu schieben.

In der letzten Folge wird Crowther tot in seiner Zelle aufgefunden. Liz glaubt nicht an einen Selbstmord. Ihr wird plötzlich klar, dass die Verschwörung nicht von Crowther orchestriert wurde, sondern noch größere Dimensionen hat.

pr.t: Grantchester - Ermittler im Auftrag des Herrn
pr.d: Ein scheinbar einfacher Fall entwickelt sich zu einem komplexen Geflecht aus Täuschung und internationaler Intrige: Zwei Männer werden vergiftet, einer von ihnen stirbt - doch schnell stellt sich die Frage.

Will wird nach einem Unfall von Polizist Mac gerettet. Geordie und Will geraten in einen Mordfall an einem Bauernpaar, bei dem Verwandte verdächtig sind. Will wird entführt und entdeckt die Wahrheit. Leonard wird von Elliot schikaniert.

Markus Gellert vertritt den Rapper Dogan Özdil, den eine internationale Plattenfirma unter Vertrag nehmen will. Nur ist Dogan noch bei Murat Sahin unter Vertrag. Dogan behauptet, Murat habe seine Karriere nicht befördert.

Die 15-jährige Milena Rönert will, dass ihrer Mutter Annelie das Sorgerecht entzogen wird. Der Grund: Eine internationale Modelagentur hat Milena einen Vertrag angeboten. Für Milena würde damit ihr Traum von einer Modelkarriere wahr werden.

Julia Klug kehrt zurück nach Berlin. Gezwungenermaßen. Hoch verschuldet, weil einem Betrüger auf den Leim gegangen, muss sie mit Baby Ellie wieder bei ihren nichtsahnenden Eltern unterschlüpfen, zurück nach Hause, von wo sie vor 13 Jahren regelrecht geflohen war. Es kommt für Julia noch schlimmer: Die SEK-erfahrene Elitepolizistin muss ab jetzt ausgerechnet im Betrugsdezernat der Polizeidirektion 7 arbeiten.

Die verzweifelte Claudia Prinz will sich in die Spree stürzen. Sie ist auf einen Heiratsschwindler hereingefallen, der sie nicht nur betrogen, sondern obendrein um 10.000 Euro erleichtert hat. Für Julia Klug, die ja selber Opfer eines Heiratsschwindlers wurde, ist klar: Dieser Betrüger - er nennt sich Costa Schettino - muss zur Strecke gebracht werden! Ihr Chef Johannes Sonntag sieht das ganz anders: So ein Fall gehört in einen Groschenroman - nicht in die Zuständigkeit des Betrugsdezernats.

Halbnackt erscheint der aus dem Krankenhaus entflohene Herzpatient Norbert Brenner auf der Wache. Er will einen Diebstahl anzeigen: Sein Herz wurde geklaut! Deshalb will er auch gleich noch einen Mord anzeigen - den Mord an ihm. Marianne übergibt den seltsamen Fall an Julia. Ihr erzählt Brenner seine unglaubliche Geschichte: Wenige Minuten vor der Operation wurde die für ihn lebenswichtige Herztransplantation unter fadenscheinigen Gründen abgesagt.

Direktionschefin Marei Schiller wird wegen sexueller Belästigung vom Dienst suspendiert. Ihr wird vorgeworfen, dem Unternehmer Christian Raabe - einem der großzügigsten Wohltäter der Stadt - in den Schritt gefasst zu haben. Dabei hat sie sich nur gegen dessen plumpe Annäherungsversuche gewehrt. Aber wer glaubt der Chefin der Polizeidirektion 7, wenn Raabe die Situation ganz anders darstellt?

Der Fernsehstar Jeanette Biedermann wird von der aufgebrachten Besitzerin eines Schreibwarenladens Frau Krutsch auf offener Straße beschuldigt, sie um 150 Euro geprellt zu haben! Frau Krutsch ist verdammt sauer auf Jeanette: Sie wirft ihr vor, einen Schulranzen und diverse Schreibutensilien gekauft, aber die Rechnung dafür niemals bezahlt zu haben. Offensichtlich sind die großen Stars sich zu fein, ihre Schulden zu bezahlen! Die Begegnung mit dem Idol hatte sich Patrick Klug anders vorgestellt.

Die Norddeutsche Svea heiratet ihren Mann Peter, der aus einem Alpendorf stammt. Dort wartet ihr Schwiegervater Joseph Pirnegger bereits auf die Gelegenheit, seinen verlorenen Sohn endlich wieder nach Hause zu locken.

Svea Classen nimmt den Kampf gegen die Machenschaften ihres Schwiegervaters auf: Als frisch gekürte Bürgermeisterin der Gemeinde Klamm kämpft die Hanseatin für die Interessen der betrogenen Bergbauern. Sie entwickelt ein Konzept für den Naturpark.

Der Sturm ist das große Gesprächsthema. Im Hotel bricht Panik aus, als niemand weiß, wie man den Tresor öffnet, und der Lebensmittelhändler bezahlt werden will. Als Frau Andersen aus dem Krankenhaus zurückkehrt, liest sie einen beunruhigenden Brief.

Nach den tragischen Ereignissen greift Fie Molly Andersen unter die Arme. Morten und Amandas Vater geraten aneinander. Einige Herren wollen das Hotel wechseln, ihre Frauen jedoch sind dagegen. Der Graf trifft sich mit seinem mysteriösen Anrufer.

Der Sommer neigt sich dem Ende zu. Sie wird angeboten, über den Winter zu bleiben, doch sie zögert. Olga sucht noch immer nach einer Frau für ihren Sohn. Sibylle mag ihn sehr, hat aber Skrupel. Derweil erhält der Graf einen neuen Erpressungsbrief.

Amanda Madsen und die anderen Stammgäste aus Kopenhagen sind zurück in Andersens Strandhotel und die nächste Sommersaison ist eröffnet. Doch was ist aus Morten geworden, der unter Mordverdacht von der Polizei geflohen ist?

Amandas Vater versucht, sie zur Heirat mit Ditmar zu zwingen. Im Gegenzug würde er Morten bei der Polizei entlasten. Jedoch hat Amandas kleine Schwester ebenfalls ein Wörtchen mitzureden. Auch Max ist alles andere als begeistert von der Hochzeit.

Die in England geborene Joan Stanley (Judi Dench) studiert in Cambridge Physik und verliebt sich auf dem Campus in den ebenso attraktiven wie manipulativen Leo Galich (Tom Hughes). Durch ihn beginnt Joan das Leben durch einen ganz neuen Blickwinkel zu sehen. Sie wird zu einer Sympathisantin der sowjetischen und kommunistischen Partei und viele Jahre später, während des Zweiten Weltkriegs, als Beamtin der britischen Regierung für ein geheimes Nuklear-Forschungsprojekt angestellt. Dabei erkennt.

Selbst im Nachtzug kann Miss Marple dem Verbrechen nicht entkommen. Sie beobachtet einen brutalen Mord in einem vorbeifahrenden Zug. Die Polizei findet jedoch keine Leiche und hält die Dame für verrückt. Das lässt Miss Marple nicht auf sich sitzen.

Sie begannen mit einem aufsehenerregenden Skandal, machten ihre Liebe, die gegenseitige Anziehung, ihren Streit, den Reichtum und ihre Süchte öffentlich und wurden so zum Glamourpaar der Swinging Sixties: Elizabeth Taylor und Richard Burton. Sie ist seit ihrer Kindheit ein verwöhnter Hollywoodstar, er ist ein walisischer Bergarbeitersohn, der sich zu einem der großen Theatermimen seines Landes entwickelt hatte. Sie begegnen sich am Filmset in Rom.

pr.t: The United States vs. Billie Holiday
pr.d: Die legendäre Jazzsängerin Billie Holiday gerät während ihrer Karriere immer wieder ins Visier der Behörden, weil ihr Song „Strange Fruit", der sich mit dem Lynchen von Afroamerikanern beschäftigt, als revolutionär und gefährlich eingestuft wurde. Das Federal Bureau of Narcotics lässt nichts unversucht, um das Leben der Sängerin auf den Kopf zu stellen. Billie Holiday weigert sich trotzdem, das Lied aus ihrer Setlist zu nehmen.

Peru ist ein Land dramatischer Gegensätze: Obwohl tropische Regenwälder mehr als die Hälfte des Landes ausmachen, erstrecken sich im westlichen Teil im Schatten der Andenkette gewaltige Wüsten mit einer einzigartigen Tierwelt.

Die Reise geht in den Südosten Perus, wo sich die Region Madre de Dios erstreckt, die nach dem gleichnamigen Fluss benannt ist. Der tropische Regenwald beherbergt eine riesige, auf der Welt einzigartige Vielfalt an Pflanzen- und Tierarten.

Deutschland in der Mitte der goldenen Zwanzigerjahre. Sechs Jahre nach Ausrufung der ersten deutschen Republik scheint die junge Demokratie endlich stabil zu sein, doch der Tod von Reichspräsident Friedrich Ebert im Februar 1925 erschüttert das Land.

In den Jahren 1931 bis 1933 nutzten Gegner der Demokratie die Krise, um das Parlament zu entmachten. Gezeigt wird der Weg in den Abgrund, wobei eine Diktatur, eine Monarchie oder der Kommunismus als mögliches Ende thematisiert werden.

Am 30. Januar 1933 hieven Konservative und Monarchisten Hitler ins Amt des Reichskanzlers. Sie denken, ihn zähmen zu können. Tatsächlich braucht er nur 18 Monate voller Willkür, Rechtsbruch und Mord, bis er die ganze Macht in Händen hält.

Aktuelle gesellschaftliche, politische und wirtschaftliche Themen stehen im Mittelpunkt einer vertiefenden Betrachtung. Durch sachliche Reportagen, fundierte Hintergrundberichte und Analysen werden relevante Ereignisse umfassend beleuchtet.

Mal sind sie lustig, mal nervig, mal sexistisch, mal eine Frechheit, Werbespots. Werbung spiegelt immer die Gesellschaft wider, schaut dem Volk gewissermaßen aufs "Maul". Das gilt auch für die Rolle der Frau und ihr Bild in der Werbung.

Die 90er liefern ikonische Battles um Musik, Sammeltrends, Sport und Kinohits. Im Musik-Battle treffen zwei Welten aufeinander: die Backstreet Boys, perfekt gecastet für Teenie-Fans, gegen die bodenständige Kelly Family mit handgemachtem Folk-Pop.

Schnabeltiere, Dingos oder Tasmanische Teufel - in Australiens weiten Wäldern leben Tiere, die es nur dort gibt, nirgendwo sonst. Ihre außergewöhnliche Anpassungsfähigkeit ermöglicht ihnen ein Überleben in dieser oftmals feindlichen Natur.

In der Sendung stellt sich eine Persönlichkeit mit interessanter Vita aus Gesellschaft, Kultur, Wirtschaft oder Politik in einem intensiven Gespräch über Hintergründe, Lebensentwürfe und Erfahrungen den Fragen der Moderatoren.

Es geht um das Wichtigste aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Kultur, Sport und Wissenschaft. Korrespondenten der ARD sorgen für schnelle und präzise News. Die Tagesschau-Ausgaben zur vollen Stunde werden teilweise mit Videotext-Untertiteln ausgestrahlt.

pr.d: Die Folge erweckt die Inspirationen hinter J.R.R. Tolkiens populärer Fantasy-Welt Mittelerde zum Leben. Die große Popularität von Tolkiens Universum ist zeitlos und weltweit verbreitet. Generationen von Lesern sind davon geprägt worden.

pr.t: Tolkien. Die wahre Geschichte der Ringe
pr.d: Lange ging man davon aus, dass Tolkiens Werk in erster Linie Fantasy sei. Jüngere Forschungen zeigen, wie stark die Weltgeschichte in Mittelerde eingeflossen ist. Vor allem Tolkiens Teilnahme am Ersten Weltkrieg hat zahlreiche Spuren hinterlassen.

At 14 years old, Daniel Bartlam killed his mother with a claw hammer then sought to cover his tracks by concocting a story that came straight from a soap opera.
Fred and Rosemary West murdered 12 women including 2 of their daughters in one of the most shocking cases Britain has ever seen. Were they born to kill; or did their mothers make them into monsters?

pr.d: Marilyn Kananen has vanished, and her children are afraid that their abusive father has returned.
Two years after a 13-year-old girl was taken from her home, her skull is found.
Cold case detectives rely on old witnesses and new technology to solve the case of the slaying of Lisa Summers, who was found dead with little evidence of her killer.

Fred and Rose West raped, tortured and murdered at least a dozen young British girls between 1967 and 1987, including several of their own daughters. Learn how two of Britain's most notorious serial killers were able to get away with their crimes for so long, how they hid the victim's remains within the confines of their own home, and how they were eventually taken down.
Documentary series examining what led Fred and Rose West to become serial killers.

pr.t: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
pr.d: Focuses on the notorious house which the couple shared in Gloucester. Fred and Rose murdered their first three victims - Anna McFall, Charmaine West and then Rena Costello - because they 'got in the way'. But when they moved into 25 Cromwell Street, the couple began to kill for sexual thrills.

pr.t: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
pr.d: Looks at how a dogged police officer, Hazel Savage, fought to have the Wests' patio excavated when she became suspicious about the whereabouts of their daughter. The film also includes insights from both Fred and Rose West's former solicitors.
In Norfolk, an otherwise unassuming summer evening is shaken by an armed robbery. A vehicle is stolen, and innocent people are shot.

Detective Inspector Burgess of Norwich CID has a problem as the number of home burglaries has rocketed. Looking at the evidence, officers suspect that one man is potentially responsible for a large part of the spike in residential crime.

pr.t: Wayne Couzens: Killer in Plain Sight
pr.d: Using interviews with expert witnesses, detectives and members of law enforcement, it reveals the true story of Wayne Couzens, asks how he was able to hide from scrutiny for so long, and considers the larger problem of misogyny in the police force.
