pr.d: James Duncan's family's search for him halts when the details of his murder are revealed, and they are almost as shocking as the murderer's identity.
Investigators, family, and the small town of Logan race against the clock to bring Summer Inman home alive after she is violently abducted.
When a quiet bachelor lets a mysterious woman into his life, the results are disastrous for both him and his family.
When Jake Millison vanishes without a trace, his loyal friends stop at nothing to unearth the shocking truth behind that fateful night.
When a revered small-town physician lies about his whereabouts the night of his son's murder, police investigate the death of his other son seven years earlier.

A motel housekeeper in Oakley, Kan., discovers the body of her co-worker Alice Pepperl; the room lacks hard evidence to point to a suspect, but a special coin taken from the cash register could be all it takes.
Investigators hunt a sexual sadist who stalks and preys on young mothers in Sioux Falls, S.D.
Exploring Tupac Shakur's meteoric rise to fame and the troubles he faced that eventually lead to his untimely death. Now, in 2023, new information has surfaced and flipped the case on its head.

On a cold dark winter's night on the Upper West Side of Manhattan, New York City, one man made a fateful decision that changed the world forever. It was December 8th 1980 and John Lennon was about to take his final steps.
Chronicling President John F. Kennedy's life and career, and probing conspiracy theories surrounding his assassination in Dallas Nov. 22, 1963.

John Fitzgerald Kennedy's assassination is a memory etched onto the minds of most Americans. An exploration of the many theories that have arisen and sought to explain why the president was assassinated.
A plunge into the evening of the murder, the controversial trial, and Oscar's early release from prison.
NFL's Rae Carruth is tried for ordering a hit on his girlfriend. Armed with her account and the testimonies of the shooter and driver, prosecutors push for the ultimate punishment.
Meet the world's most venomous snake living in Central Australia and discover the unusual stonefish, a deadly fish with a fatal sting that lurks beneath the tropical waters.
Ian takes a look at the hunting patterns of great white sharks in order to determine if they are intelligent hunters.
Journey to the amazing Ningaloo reef in Australia to catch a mass coral spawning. This natural phenomenon provides a banquet for the whale shark.
Ian joins divers heading into the ocean off the Poor Knights Islands off the coast of New Zealand to get up close and personal with mako sharks.

The Baltic Sea holds boundless wealth in shapes, colours and life. Born at the end of the ice age, it is the biggest brackish-water sea in the world. Each summer, thousands of tourists flock to its beaches, but not many people know the abundance of wildlife that hides in this special ecosystem.

pr.t: Alpine Lakes: Dark Depths and Icy Heights
pr.d: Europe's most fascinating landscapes from an entirely new perspective.
An insight into the Coral Triangle, with more than three quarters of the planet's coral species, and both the world's smallest and largest fish.
An exploration of the Coral Triangle's bays, lined with volcanic ash and mud, with their strange marine adaptions.
Explores the world's largest living structure: the Great Barrier Reef on the eastern coast of Australia.
Cameras reveal the last secrets of Africa's largest wild lions by following two prides.

The lions' new home will be a sanctuary on the edge of Dinokeng, a South African game reserve spanning 18,000 square metres. Kevin Richardson's task ahead includes planning and designing the new enclosures, and securing permits to move the animals.
Not only are the animals regularly rotated into new enclosures to prevent repetitive behaviour developing out of boredom, but Kevin also has to practice loading them in and out of the van.
Meet the world's most venomous snake living in Central Australia and discover the unusual stonefish, a deadly fish with a fatal sting that lurks beneath the tropical waters.

Steve Backshall helps at the hedgehog hospital and meets a family of otters. Miranda Krestovnikoff finds out if Lorraine the slow loris is pregnant, and Lindsey Chapman sends out Coco the cat as a roving reporter.

Steve Backshall meets one of the night's most fearsome hunters, a barn owl. Miranda Krestovnikoff looks for orphaned pine marten Polly in Scotland. Lindsey Chapman witnesses backyard drama between badgers and a young mum fox.
Miranda Krestovnikoff guides a wolf pack through their internal strife. Philippa Forrester sees what badgers get up to underground in a specially built 'Big Brother' set.
Australasia is home to a grand diversity of species, both animal and plant.
The first European explorers trekked through Australia's desert, which included 400km-long mountain ranges and towering red dunes.
Discovering the wildlife and stunning landscapes of Australia, New Zealand, New Guinea, New Caledonia and Lord Howe Island.

A deep dive into Borneo's heartland forest, travelling up rivers and hills to spot wild orangutans, elephants, proboscis monkeys, hornbills and giant insects. This island harbours the world's oldest primary forest and a rich ecosystem.
Take a deep dive into the lives of these cheeky, clever, water-loving primates.

A thousand elephants come together in a crucial annual gathering in northern Kenya, whilst facing deadly threats from both predators and poachers. Liz Bonnin leads a team of scientists and film-makers, following individual elephants day by day.

100,000 caribou face starving bears and wolves, deadly frozen rivers and rugged mountains as they undertake the world's longest land migration, 5,000 kilometres through the frozen Arctic wilderness of Canada and Alaska.
Japan is famous for its distinctive seasons. However, there is much more to know about the seasons in Japan. Dramatic seasonal changes have been creating beautiful natural phenomenon.

Japan is famous for its distinctive seasons; people know about spring's cherry blossoms in Tokyo, summer's tropical beaches in Okinawa, autumn tints in Kyoto and winter's powder snow in Hokkaido; however, there's more to know about the seasons.
An obscure forest that is home to many unknown species; in Biebrza, elks, water spiders, sea eagles, and others thrive in nature's abundance.

pr.d: Mary hat ein paar Leckereien zusammengestellt, mit denen man jeden Besucher beeindrucken kann. Sie empfiehlt, mit dem Dessert zu beginnen. Eine einfache Pavlova ist perfekt geeignet. Dann zaubert Mary Steak Bourguignon und serviert Pasta.

Mary will dabei helfen, das Chaos in der Küche auf ein Minimum zu reduzieren und hat dafür einen Tipp. Am besten, man bereitet alles in nur einer Pfanne zu. Mary hat vier Rezeptideen, mit denen das ganz einfach möglich ist.

Mary widmet sich der französischen Küche, die für sie immer etwas ganz Besonderes ist. Sie startet mit dem Käsesandwich "Croque Madame" und geht dann zu einer Zwiebelsuppe und einem Rib-Eye-Steak über. Sie rundet alles mit einem Omelette-Soufflé ab.

Gute Vorbereitung ist in der Küche das A und O. Besonders für Menschen, die wenig Zeit haben. Viele Gerichte können am Wochenende vorgekocht werden. Mary zeigt einige Rezepte, um Abwechslung in die gesunde Ernährung zu bringen.

Häufig bleiben nach dem Essen Reste übrig, die dann viel zu oft den Weg in den Mülleimer finden. Das muss jedoch nicht sein. Denn aus Resten lassen sich wieder leckere Gerichte zubereiten. Mary zeigt dies an leckeren Beispielen.

pr.t: Hochzeit auf den ersten Blick - Australien
pr.d: Die ersten zwei Paare müssen entscheiden, ob sie ihre Ehe auch im richtigen Leben weiterführen wollen. Olivia möchte an Jacksons Seite bleiben. Jackson bezweifelt jedoch, ob ihre Beziehung auch außerhalb des Experiments funktionieren wird.

pr.t: Hochzeit auf den ersten Blick - Australien
pr.d: Die Paare stehen vor der endgültigen Entscheidung und reisen davor in ihre Heimat, um dort mit ihren Angehörigen zu sprechen. Dann finden die Kandidaten heraus, wer sich für eine gemeinsame Zukunft bereit fühlt und welche Paare scheitern.

Das Pärchen Tom und Erin weiß, dass es an der Zeit ist, eine Entscheidung über ihr renovierungsbedürftiges Haus zu treffen. Erin liebt es und möchte bleiben, aber Tom glaubt, dass ihr perfektes Haus nur ein Schnäppchen entfernt ist.

Mark und Vicki wohnen mit ihren Töchtern im oberen Stockwerk ihres Hauses, während der Großvater im unteren Stockwerk wohnt. Vicki glaubt, dass ihr Haus auseinanderfällt und möchte umziehen, aber Mark glaubt, dass das Haus repariert werden kann.

pr.t: Design Down Under - Wohnvisionen in Australien
pr.d: Eine viel beschäftigte Krankenschwester wünscht sich mehr Funktionalität in ihrem Haus aus den 1900er Jahren und bittet Georgia und Richie um Hilfe. Als sie mit der Arbeit beginnen, überdenkt die Kundin ihre Wunschliste und belastet damit ihr Budget.

pr.t: Design Down Under - Wohnvisionen in Australien
pr.d: Clare und Steve leben in Clares ehemaligem Elternhaus. Sie wollen ihr Zuhause renovieren und erhalten Hilfe von Georgia und Richie. Während diese mit dem Umbau beginnen, sucht Georgia in einem Secondhandladen nach einer Glastür für die Veranda.
Dieses Mal zeigt Mary, dass köstliche Gerichte nicht unbedingt ein Vermögen kosten müssen.
Mary zeigt vier köstliche Pasta-Rezepte, die einfach sind, aber enorm viel Geschmack besitzen.

Selena Gomez besucht Lemon Grove, wo sie vom Chef Marcel Vigneron mit drei außergewöhnlichen Gerichten empfangen wird. Selena kreiert ein farbenfrohes Gericht mit ungewöhnlichen Zutaten, und Marcel muss entscheiden, ob es sein neues Special wird.

Selena Gomez besucht Moo's Craft Barbecue in Los Angeles, wo sie die besten Texas BBQ-Gerichte entdeckt. Die Betreiber Andrew und Michelle Muñoz fordern sie heraus, eine eigene Wurst zu kreieren, die eine besondere Note in ihre Speisekarte bringt.
Auf Tasmanien bewundert Gordon Ramsay die Natur und sammelt außergewöhnliche Zutaten für ein regional geprägtes Festessen. Dabei lässt sich der Spitzenkoch auch von Haien und Schlangen nicht stoppen.

Der Spitzenkoch Gordon Ramsay reist in die südafrikanische Provinz KwaZulu-Natal und erfährt mehr über den Umgang mit traditionellen Braai-Holzgrills. Im Indischen Ozean begibt Ramsay sich außerdem auf die Suche nach Muscheln.

Der Ex-Teilnehmer und Sternekoch Egor Hopp ist zu Gast als Juror. Er stellt die Kandidaten vor harte Aufgaben: Die Speisekammern bleiben geschlossen, stattdessen müssen sie mit von ihm gepackten Einkaufskörben und speziellen Einkaufszetteln kochen.
pr.sub: Kleine Produktauswahl, aber großer Geschmack für Egor Hopp

pr.d: Joanna und Chip renovieren ein Haus am Wald, in dem der Sohn eines guten Freundes wohnen soll.

Josh ist musikalisch und möchte die Möglichkeit haben, seiner Leidenschaft auch in den neuen vier Wänden ausüben zu können. Chip und Joanna gestalten für ihn und seiner Frau ein eher unscheinbares Objekt in ein schönes, klassisches Haus um.

Gastjurorin Clara Hunger bringt knifflige Geschmackskombinationen wie knusprige Aubergine oder süßen Schweinebauch mit. Während sie für nachhaltige und innovative Küche steht, treibt Steffen Henssler sein Team beim Teamkochen an.

Der britische Spitzenkoch Gordon Ramsay besucht seinen Kollegen Eric Cook in New Orleans, um mehr über die Grundlagen der Cajun-Küche zu erfahren. Daraus entwickelt sich ein abenteuerlicher Trip durch die Sümpfe Louisianas.

Gordon Ramsay begibt sich auf die indonesische Insel Sumatra, um sich mit der dortigen Kochkunst vertraut zu machen. Bei der Durchquerung eines Höhlensystems und der Begegnung einer Büffelherde ist außerdem voller Körpereinsatz gefragt.

War veteran John Rambo takes on the entire Vietnamese army, plus Soviet advisers, when he is released from prison and sent back to present-day Vietnam in search of American prisoners of war still being held in enemy custody.

He becomes easy prey for fashion designer Jacobim Mugatu, who signs Derek to star in his 'Derelicte' fashion show, then brainwashes him to kill Malaysia's prime minister.

Jim and Michelle are getting married and Jim struggles to win over his future in-laws and deal with his embarrassing dad. Meanwhile, Stifler isn't invited to the ceremony, but he's determined not to be left out.

When Pete and Ellie decide to start a family, they stumble into the world of foster care adoption. Now, Pete and Ellie must try to learn the ropes of instant parenthood in the hope of becoming a family.

A police chase becomes a manhunt when officers decide to have a closer look at a car behaving strangely on the road, and discover an unlicensed driver behind the wheel.

Two retirees disappear from their home near Rutland Water, and forensic scientists search for evidence to prove that the pair had been murdered.

However, when John Coffey, a massive man convicted of brutally killing a pair of young sisters, arrives, things start to get strange. Beyond his simple, naïve nature and a deathly fear of the dark, Coffey seems to possess a prodigious, supernatural gift. Paul begins to question whether Coffey was truly guilty of murdering the two girls.

Roxy Hart is sent to prison for shooting her lying lover. In prison, she meets tabloid darling and headline singer, Velma Kelly, who is also in for a double murder. With the help of a slick Chicago lawyer, she learns to play the media game and vies for the valuable press attention that will get her out of jail.
Two young men during World War I set out to record the lives, voices and music of their American countrymen.

When a perfect night with a perfect stranger ends suddenly the next morning, Charlotte searches for answers and meaning in her life. However, she soon uncovers a shocking secret that changes everything she knows about the man who captured her heart.

The publisher and editor of The Washington Post risk both their careers and freedom to expose a massive cover-up of government secrets that covers three decades and four presidents.

The son of a loving but strict single parent, the boy rebels against her distrust of rock music and the surrounding drug culture by writing album reviews which attract sponsorship from a big magazine to tour with a band. Ignoring all advice, he befriends band members and groupies alike.

A few years later, fires and other problems prevented the camp from reopening. In 1979, ignoring the camp curse, a new owner opens the place, and before long, a mysterious figure is stalking the area, and once again, people are being murdered.

Luther Krank, fed up with the commercialism of Christmas, decides to skip the holiday and go on holiday with his wife, an easy decision to make with their daughter away anyway, but when she suddenly decides to come home, uproar ensues in the rush to celebrate Christmas at the last minute.
All a retired widower wants for Christmas is for his family to get along. If they can honour his wish and spend five whole, happy days together, it may just be a Christmas miracle.
Two worlds collide when a music manager of a boy band and the guitarist in a death metal group connect over a Christmas hit they both desperately need.
Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

Finding out that he's actually human, Buddy the elf leaves the North Pole to find his real dad in bustling New York, but when he gets there, his mean old dad doesn't want to know. While he's trying to convince his father, he gets a job as a department store elf, which he should be perfectly cut out for.
As his life unravels around him just in time for Christmas, Bernard dusts off an antique jewellery box that happens to contain trapped genie Flora, who might just be able to help him.
Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.

A gadget salesman is looking for a special gift for his son and finds one at a store in Chinatown. The shopkeeper is reluctant to sell him the 'mogwai' but sells it to him with the warning to never expose him to bright light, water, or to feed him after midnight. All of this happens and the result is a gang of gremlins that decide to tear up the town on Christmas Eve.

Dumped and depressed, English rose Iris agrees to swap homes with similarly unlucky in love Californian Amanda for a much-needed break. Iris finds herself in a palatial Hollywood mansion while Amanda navigates the lanes of a picture-perfect English village. Soon enough, both lovelorn ladies bump into local lads perfect for a romantic pick-me-up.
After Claire inherits her uncle's Christmas-themed bar, she must square off against a neighbouring competitor to save it from its drowning debt.

The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbours in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realises there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all.

While he's trying to convince his father, he gets a job as a department store elf, which he should be perfectly cut out for.
A musician who neglects his family in pursuit of his career is tragically killed in a car accident, but is given a second chance to get back into his son's life when he is reincarnated as a snowman.

Vincent Vega and Jules Winnfield are hitmen with a penchant for philosophical discussions. In this ultra-hip, multi-strand crime movie, their storyline is interwoven with those of their boss, gangster Marsellus Wallace; his actress wife, Mia; struggling boxer Butch Coolidge; master fixer Winston Wolfe and a nervous pair of armed robbers, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny.

Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.

A divorced train commuter passes the house she used to live in with her husband every day. To distract herself she creates a fictional perfect world for her former neighbours in her head. This is ruined when one of the neighbours goes missing.
A young woman joins a charming con man on the run, leaving a trail of crime and passion as they hustle through the Southeast in search of her estranged mother.

A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril.
He balances books by day and bodies by night. A maths savant hiding behind a CPA desk, Christian Wolff crunches numbers for cartels and killers - until one error adds him to the equation.
In a dystopian future America, a team of military-embedded journalists races against time to reach Washington, D.C., before rebel factions descend upon the White House.

Seafaring drama based on the true story of a commercial fishing boat crew who become caught in a terrifying storm off the coast of Massachusetts. In the autumn of 1991, a fishing boat captain is determined to set sail despite the adverse weather conditions, but when the ice machine breaks down his decision to brave the storm rather than lose his catch results in a battle against 100ft waves.

pr.t: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
pr.d: The murder of Austria's crown prince leads Holmes, Watson and a Gypsy to a showdown with an evil genius named Moriarty.
Disowned at birth by his wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

Based on three hybridising narrative strands, three groups of villains are intent on retrieving a missing diamond. Turkish and Tommy team up with a pugilistic Irish gypsy named Mickey for the purpose of rigging unlicensed boxing matches. However, their opponent also arranges some dodgy betting with the courier of the stolen diamond, who subsequently goes missing. To complicate further, a New York gangster arrives on the scene.

DJ's birthday party becomes a surprise dual function and Ava is tasked with an important responsibility; Deborah and Marty reconnect.
Harry is brought in front of The Galactic Housing Council to answer for his crimes.
Maia's 27th birthday is thrown into chaos by the sudden and unexpected return of her best friend, Tallulah.
After reconciling, Maia and Tallulah step into their new roles as manager and client while tackling an increasingly erratic situation.
The class is convinced to fill in for the Glee Club at Greendale's Christmas pageant after Abed decides he wants them to spend the holiday together.
Shirley's ex-husband Andre proposes to her again. While planning her wedding, Shirley also considers a business proposition from Pierce.
pr.sub: Urban Matrimony and the Sandwich Arts

pr.d: On the eve of the opening of the new club-gallery, a moment between Bessy and Sabi creates tension in their relationship.
A family crisis causes Sabi to confront unresolved feelings towards their father.

Will's boss Ben and Grace overcome their differences and end up in bed together, but then Will walks in on Ben with another woman. Meanwhile, Rosario files for a divorce from Jack so she can marry Karen's gardener.

Will tries to break the bad news to Grace about Ben cheating on her, and Will also decides to help Jack fight his case against Karen, but Ben puts a stop to it because Karen is one of the firm's clients.

Will returns from the Caribbean only to discover that Jack has insinuated himself with Grace, leaving Will feeling left out. Also, Grace is having trouble choosing between two substandard boyfriends and Karen tries to implicate Rosario in smuggling to save her own skin.
Frightened Grace moves in with Will after her flat is burgled. With Jack already staying there, the flat is overcrowded and Will finally cracks, announcing that one of them must move out.

Will and Jack are shocked to discover that two of their formerly wild friends have settled down to raise an adopted baby girl. Jack is even more shocked when Will volunteers to babysit. Meanwhile, Grace taunts Karen because she thinks she's jealous of her relationship with Ben.
After an unnerving encounter, Ron installs a security system at his house and doubles down on his pursuit.
While developing a new hypothesis, Ron finds himself at the centre of a series of confusing encounters.
While investigating a new avenue, Ron is led down a dangerous path.
Shred encounters a wild weasel in an attic, and Frank slips his Slim Jim in Shred's back pocket as they approach a dozen ostriches.
A tech geek tells Frank his rabbits got into his special chocolate bars. Frank and Shred find a python wrapped around a man's neck.
Dispatch radios the team with a cougar sighting; Amit squares off with a kangaroo.

John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other.
Will and Grace try to convince themselves they are okay with dating the same man, Jack and Karen get an annoying commercial jingle stuck in their heads and must seek medical attention.
When Joe and Larry get broody, Grace offers Larry a job to distract him. Meanwhile, Jack runs over neighbour Val in his car.
When Vince invites Will to his wedding, Grace tries to stop him making a scene, while Jack fends off the advances of an amorous cop and Karen plays a high-society treasure hunt.
Jack celebrates his one-month-anniversary with Drew, who is still married to Angela. Meanwhile, Grace gets a spot on QVC trying to sell her bedsheets.
Grace is horrified to realise that she has dated three men from the same family. Will and Karen get on each other's nerves at the office until they bond over producing their own telenovela.

Michael and Jan try to land a new client by taking him out to Chilli's. Back in the office Jim finds a script written by Michael called 'Threat Level: Midnight', and the workers cannot resist acting it out. Elsewhere, Pam and Jim have their first unofficial date.
Michael's uses his discussion with the staff about their performance to steal ideas for his meeting with Jan, and Pam and Jim try and fool Dwight into thinking it's Friday.

Michael upsets employees when he starts to keep tabs on the emails going around at work, Pam suspects Angela and Dwight's relationship isn't purely professional, and Jim throws a barbecue at his home and Michael turns up.

Michael hosts a Christmas party for the staff but his gift-giving plan goes awry when everything gets swapped. Vodka shots are introduced and Jim worries someone else will get the present he chose for Pam.
Michael takes the staff on a motivational cruise aboard a party boat, but they seem to be distracted by among other things a limbo contest, and Pam and Roy set a wedding date.

pr.t: Al Murray: All You Need Is Guv
pr.d: Al Murray returns as the Pub Landlord with his like-nobody-else common sense hot-takes for the masses, offering a much-needed truth tonic for these whacked out and troubled times.
Edinburgh Comedy Awards winner John Kearns performs his new stand-up, 'The Varnishing Days', at London's Royal Court Theatre as he muses on mainstream success, his tonsure wig, and his novelty teeth.
Edelman shares his experience of covertly attending a meeting of white nationalists and coming face-to-face with the people behind the keyboards.
In 2013, the abusive boyfriend of vulnerable 17-year-old Jayden Parkinson turned to murder after learning about her pregnancy and then buried her in his uncle's grave in Oxfordshire.
The story of Valerie Graves, a grandmother who was killed in a horrific attack just days after Christmas whilst she was house-sitting for her friends' million-pound property in Bosham in 2013.

Detectives reflect on how they gathered evidence to charge Melanie McGuire with murder when her husband's remains were found in multiple suitcases after she had shot him dead in their New Jersey flat.
When a family is brutally murdered in New Mexico, suspicion falls on their daughter. A year later, a tip exposes a shocking plot and a truth no one saw coming.
Senior Constable Ahern travels around the Rangitikei District, and the Highway Cops step in when a reckless teen's speeding ends badly and a caravan loses a part at the top of the Lindis Pass.
Police respond to a call about a man who is brandishing a samurai sword, destroying his mother's house and threatening to set himself on fire, plus Saturday night fever breaks out in Newcastle.
Ash Bowden is accused of stalking when a woman learns her car will be impounded, an elderly motorcyclist is pulled over for not wearing a helmet, and an unlicensed vehicle is caught speeding.
A police chase becomes a manhunt when officers decide to have a closer look at a car behaving strangely on the road, and discover an unlicensed driver behind the wheel.

An officer inspects a resistant traveller's luggage; no mistaken identities at JFK; an impatient shopper in Detroit; a frequent traveller to drug-sourced countries is questioned; a Canadian cowboy might be a mule.
In a dramatic bust an American man makes a shocking confession and authorities discover a rare and unusual item in a strange package from Russia.
Officers realise that a Chinese man is covering for a partner in crime when he won't answer questions. What he is hiding in his luggage could have a devastating effect on biosecurity.
Dog handler Darryl gets more than he bargained for when he steps in to break up a pub fight in Exeter city centre, and the Ashburton Tactical Aid Group executes two flat raids.
From windy weather wipe-outs and the most villainous of drivers, to moments the police would rather forget, it's all caught on dashcam.

Just days after Dawn Walker married Thomas Nutt, the 52-year-old grandmother failed to meet her daughter, before a shocking discovery was made.

A look at how forensic science can help police solve serious crimes where the truth seems impossible to uncover. As the various twists and turns of each case unfold, the role of forensic science in providing answers is highlighted and examined.

pr.d: A look at the extraordinary life and times of Terry Venables, intertwined with the story of England's unforgettable run at Euro 96, with insight from players, friends, and family.
An exploration of Blackpool's fairytale rise to the ⚽ [EPL] Premier League and the extraordinary David-and-Goliath battle that followed between its multi-millionaire owners and ordinary supporters.

Going behind-the-scenes the England women's football team's historic 2022 UEFA victory. Through personal home movie footage, archive materials, and exclusive interviews with players and commentators, the women behind the Lionesses are revealed.
A glimpse into the life and work of two-time Academy Award winner Dustin Hoffman, who has starred in a host of films during his decades-long career, including 'Midnight Cowboy' and 'The Graduate'.
A glimpse into the life and career of Academy Award-winning Hollywood actor Richard Dreyfuss, whose starring roles have included 'The Goodbye Girl', 'Jaws', and 'Down and Out in Beverly Hills'.
A look at the life and career of the Oscar-nominated actor Basil Rathbone, known for his star turn as Sherlock Holmes and roles in 'David Copperfield' and 'The Adventures of Robin Hood'.
The origins of bitcoin and the identity of its anonymous creator, Satoshi Nakamoto, remains a high-stakes mystery of technology and finance.

Residents and thousands of holidaymakers grapple with rising numbers of great white sharks off the coast of Cape Cod, Massachusetts, as scientists investigate what has caused the surge and what it can reveal about ocean health.
Former England cricket captain and Sky Sports pundit Nasser Hussain discusses the individuals that have inspired him during his life and career.
Chris Harris travels to Italy to spend a week with Ferrari legend Luca Montezemolo.

The astonishing story of Canadian 🏎️ [F1] Formula 1 legend Gilles Villeneuve and French star Didier Pironi, two fearless Ferrari 🏎️ [F1] Formula 1 drivers, forever torn apart by a historic and hugely controversial moment in time.
Chronicles the rise of racing driver Nigel Mansell, the Williams F1 racing team, and how they came together to fight for the 🏎️ [F1] Formula 1 Drivers' Championship.
Former rugby league superstar Martin Offiah discusses the individuals that have inspired him in his life and career.
In 2008, Allen Stanford made a dramatic entry into the world of cricket when he landed his helicopter at Lord's with a box containing $20 million and an ambitious plan to forever transform the sport.
Now bankrupt, Allen spies a fresh opportunity in Montserrat, but his new venture in the British Overseas Territory soon attracts the attention of US and UK law enforcement agencies.
Following his departure from Montserrat, Allen moves his operation to Antigua, where he discovers the power of cricket in the Caribbean and develops plans for a new Twenty20 competition.
pr.sub: Is It Fun Being a Billionaire?

pr.d: An exploration of Blackpool's fairytale rise to the ⚽ [EPL] Premier League and the extraordinary David-and-Goliath battle that followed between its multi-millionaire owners and ordinary supporters.

In 2007, Queens Park Rangers Football Club, facing relegation and bankruptcy, was rescued by four high-profile billionaires with a vision to take a community of reluctant fans, semi-talented players, and a roster of ever-changing managers to Premiership glory. The new owners, risking ridicule and commercial failure, allowed cameras to record the extraordinary roller-coaster ride.
In Brazil, three men escape a close encounter only to realise it lasted longer than any of them thought. Plus, in Canada, a boy investigates a strange object.
In Michigan, a father and son see strange lights and call the sheriff's office. In France, a craft known as Angel Hair is spotted hovering over school grounds.
pr.sub: Bogged Down and Rows and Flows of Angel Hair

pr.d: Alice Roberts explores the story of Stewart Britain by visiting Stirling, the home of the Scottish royals who eventually took the English throne in 1603 and created Great Britain.

The sinking of RMS Titanic was one of the 20th century's greatest tragedies, but it has also been rumoured to be a crime. A range of experts take a fresh look at the case, and examine recently discovered evidence.
Ancient scriptures called the Vedas form the foundation of Hinduism.
Mike uncovers a Godzilla-size stockpile of vintage movie posters, and Robbie pays up for a pair of ultra-rare Chevy signs for the shop in Tennessee.

Chum gets a taste of a Julia Child cookbook. Rick kickflips for a vintage skateboard collection. Corey tries to score a Steph Curry jersey. Rick comes out swinging for a punching bag signed by an Academy Award-winning actor.
Rick can't help falling in love with a Viva Las Vegas movie poster from France.
Vandalism strikes the Wildman shop, inspiring Avery to finish building his Manta Coyote car kit. Meanwhile, Mike plans an auction for his car collection.
As the clock ticks towards his auction, Mike races to restore as many cars as he can, while Avery struggles to finish the Manta in time at Wildman.
Forest fires threaten Rust Valley and after his neighbour loses 350 cars, and Mike hoards fuel in a bid to save his own collection.

Paul Teutul Sr. and the OCC crew go old-school with a classic chopper design, bringing not only awareness but also acceptance to friends and family with autism. During a night out, the whole crew has an axe to grind with Paul Sr.

A look back at when being young meant testing the limits of what our bodies could survive. From launching our bikes off homemade ramps and playing chicken in traffic, to using dangerous construction sites as our playground.
A new security guard is in no mood for niceties, the bidders attempt to reel in some fishing gear and a mobile home is a tempting prospect that some cannot resist.
A mysterious concrete block and a trailer full of hay mean big opportunities and lead to unusual alliances within the group.
Lori eyes a bin with a tanning bed; a bin with fake walls intrigues Brandon; Papa Bear and Jesse vie for a bin full of antique furniture.
Sean and the bidders visit the home of the LA County Fair and get a behind-the-scenes tour.
When Sean is only given access to the storage facility after hours, it leads to the first-ever day-to-night auction that ends in the dark.
The gang bid on some hidden bunkers in Hawaii, but trouble arises with the locals.

In West Covina, Brandi makes a serious land grab, and it pays off handsomely. Rene can't resist the mystery of a good safe. Kenny can't seem to satisfy his hunger, while Barry takes an opportunity to poach from the competition.
pr.sub: All Hail, King Brandi: The Rule-her of West Covina

pr.d: Rene goes big; Ivy scores a packed locker and stumbles across an antique of unusual origin; Darrell grabs a smaller unit but finds that good things do, indeed, come in petite packages sometimes.

Rene gets lukewarm results bobbing for profits in Stanton. Dusty finds a hoard of quality equipment, inking himself a decent payday. Looking for treasure, Brandi ends up with the green in an unexpected manner.
pr.sub: Stanton in the Place Where You Work

pr.d: Barry believes all the whales are coming to the big auction in Fullerton as he takes Dusty under his wing to test him. Rene makes some dainty discoveries, and Darrell's tool locker becomes quite eye-opening.
The women outnumber the men in Rosamond, as Dusty and his girlfriend discover a stockpile of vintage TV memorabilia; Brandi enlists the help of both Danielle and Lisa to dig for gold.
Lancaster turns into Ivy's honeypot, so everyone had better watch out, or they might get stung; Lisa plans to use her brain when selecting lockers; Dusty and Tollbooth Lupe do a mitzvah.

A look at the biggest collection of Roman writing tablets in Britain, giving insight into what Roman London was really like. Off the coast of Kent, a dive into the English Channel reveals the biggest marine excavation since the Mary Rose, an 18th-century East India Company ship packed with silver.

Alice discovers the well-preserved writing tablets, swords and domestic items left by Romans at Vindolanda during a time of British rebellion. On the Scottish island of Iona, there are traces of a long-lost monastery and pilgrimage site that was originally built by the legendary Saint Columba, and has been compared to Jerusalem. In the east of Scotland, a weapons hoard belonging to a wealthy Bronze Age warrior is unearthed.

pr.t: The Rise and Fall of the Roman Empire
pr.d: Rome is a young, aggressive republic, but the Empire is shaped by decades of battle against Carthage, and driven by the ambition of its leaders and ruthless generals.

pr.t: The Rise and Fall of the Roman Empire
pr.d: When the Roman Empire is the most powerful it has ever been, Germanic invasions, the plague and a new leader plunges Rome into chaos, divided into two factions which causes a decline Rome cannot recover from.

In Queensland, a musician wakes to find himself inexplicably transported from his bed into a remote rainforest. Was this an alien abduction?

pr.d: Pablo loses his coin and worries that his team won't win without it. The gang pretend to be explorers and begin the search for Pablo's lucky charm.
Emily Elizabeth announces it's Backwards Day. She has all sorts of fun with Clifford - until they break a special model boat.
Emily opens a day care and invites pets from all over town. Everything goes as planned, until the gang sometimes realise life is different to stories.
Samantha and Emily Elizabeth have their first sleepover, so must help Clifford realise that he can have fun on his own.
Emily Elizabeth and Samantha write their own newspaper and discover that the Island is filled with fun and interesting things to write about.

Tickety Town is covered in fallen leaves, so Tommy and Tallulah use McCoggins' new prototype street sweeper to clear them. However, in their eagerness to speed things up, they go against his instructions and press the turbo button. Suddenly, the sweeper goes haywire, rampaging through town and sucking up anything in its path, including Madame Au Lait's clock key and very nearly Hopparoo too.

The whole town gathers to take part in McCoggins' treasure hunt to find the most cogs and be the winner. Knowing that McCoggins hides the cogs in the same places every year, Tommy and Tallulah are cruising to victory until they realise that a quick win will spoil everyone's day. The twins decide to borrow McCoggins' special clockwork roller skates to put the cogs back, but the skates zoom out of control.

The twins decide that everyone must get active and turn Tickety Town into a boot camp. With Tommy banging his drum and Tallulah blowing on her trumpet, soon everyone is lifting, running, puffing, and panting. They are all so exhausted that they fall fast asleep, but with Chime Time imminent, they must find a way to wake up Pufferty's wheels.

When Hopparoo bursts all their bubbles with his sharp ears, the twins use McCoggins' extra-strong bubble mixture instead and blow a bubble so huge that it engulfs Battersby, Madame Au Lait, McCoggins, Lopsiloo, Chikidee, and finally Tommy and Tallulah themselves. The twins will need to find Hopparoo, as only his sharp ears can free them for Chime Time.

In their efforts to surprise the bunny, they give the Spring Chicks such a fright that they barricade themselves in front of the clock house, blocking the way to Chime Time.

Madame Au Lait is teaching the twins pottery and shows them a magnificent cow pot that she made on her wheel to inspire them, but they accidentally smash it when she leaves them to their enthusiastic pot-making. The twins only make things worse when they try to repair it, as huge quantities of clay fly from their wheel into the town, blocking Pufferty's tracks.

Hopparoo finds himself disappointed during Measuring Time, leaving Tommy and Tallulah to offer up ideas about how to add inches, but a super-tall rabbit rampaging through town on stilts can only cause chaos.

Tommy and Tallulah are playing pirates as they hunt for Madame Au Lait's treasure, but rival pirate Hopparoo keeps trying to commandeer their cardboard boat by telling them it is Chime Time, causing them twice to abandon ship and run. So they do not believe him when Chime Time really comes around.

As the dry season takes hold in Luangwa Valley, lagoons dry up and verdant grasslands will gradually turn to dust. Animals must take advantage while they can.
South Luangwa National Park is one of Africa's great wild places. The life of every animal is linked to the two vastly different seasons - the wet and the dry.

pr.t: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
pr.d: Joining Alan at Manor Farm are Chris McCausland, Sort Your Life Out's Dilly Carter and actress Rachael Stirling. Plus, the second instalment of the Wildlife Sanctuary in the making, Urban Birder David Lindo gets up close with pelicans, and Ian Burrell has a good measure of rum hot toddies
A round-up of the latest headlines

Clodagh McKenna demonstrates four of her favourite recipes for quick and fabulous suppers, including a chicken curry, and creamy Gruyère baked eggs. She then takes an emotional trip down memory lane to share a speedy pancetta and garlic mussels dish inspired by her dad, before whipping up a pan of cheesy lemony ate-night Alfredo pasta
Round-up of the latest headlines

England v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' final match of the round-robin stage, held at Allianz Stadium Twickenham. England produced an excellent display when these teams last met a year ago, claiming a 33 - 19 victory to end a run of three straight defeats at the hands of the All Blacks. With analysis from Ugo Monye, Sean Fitzpatrick and Danny Care, pitchside reports from Topsy Ojo, and commentary from Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay

Ireland v South Africa (Kick-off 4.40pm). All the action from the match at Aviva Stadium, as both teams conclude their round-robin fixtures. These nations last faced each other 12 months ago, when the world champions claimed a 24-13 victory in a chaotic encounter that saw Ireland receive five cards, even playing with 12 men at the end of the first half, and the Springboks also get reduced to 14 men in the second half. With analysis from Bryan Habana and David Flatman, pitchside inserts by Claire Thomas and Brian O'Driscoll, and commentary from Miles Harrison and Gordon D'Arcy
Round-up of the latest headlines

Stephen Mulhern hosts another charity edition of the game show, with Stephen Mangan, Kemi Rodgers and Tom Allen all trying to say what they see, as they guess well-known phrases for the chance to win a £50,000 jackpot for their chosen good causes

pr.d: Stewart McCracken und sein Kollege Elmore Victor statten einem Textilhändler bereits zum zweiten Mal einen Besuch ab. Dieser sollte seine Schulden in Raten abzahlen. Da bislang keine Zahlung eingegangen ist, muss nun sein Besitz gepfändet werden.

Bernadette decides that she wants to be married to Wolowitz before his NASA space mission takes place. They scramble to organise a wedding ceremony at City Hall in the short time available, but their plans go awry.

In London bekommt eine Dame Besuch von Paul Bohill und seinem Kollegen Phil Short, weil sie 13.000 Mietschulden hat. Sie hat eine Stunde Zeit, um persönliche Gegenstände zusammenzupacken. Anschließend werden die Schlösser ausgetauscht.

Howard gets caught in an argument between his mum and Bernadette while at the International Space Station. Meanwhile, Ray is feeling lonely, so Sheldon invites him along to his second anniversary date with Amy.

Sheldon intervenes when he learns that Penny is thinking about breaking up with Leonard, but he is hampered by his inability to keep a secret. Meanwhile, in space, Howard is being picked on by the other astronauts.

Ein verschuldeter Zahnarzt zahlt den ausstehenden Unterhalt für seine Frau erst unter Pfändungsdruck. In Cornwall sichern die Sheriffs zwei Taxiboote für 5.500 Pfund, während ein Autohändler tief in die Tasche greifen muss.
Amy is jealous when Sheldon hires an attractive female assistant named Alex. However, it turns out that Alex is more interested in Leonard, which makes Penny feel threatened.
Wolowitz is disappointed when he doesn't receive a hero's welcome on his return from space. Meanwhile, Bernadette is out of action with a heavy cold.

Erst die drohende Pfändung eines Cabrios führt dazu, dass eine Frau ihr Geld zurückerhält. In Wales entlarven die Sheriffs zudem einen hoch verschuldeten Pub-Betreiber. Eine Werkstatt zahlt hingegen nur, weil sie um ein teures Diagnosegerät fürchtet.
The gang celebrates Halloween with a fancy dress party at Stuart's comic bookshop, but Sheldon and Amy can't agree about which costumes to wear.
Sheldon gets excited when Stephen Hawking agrees to play against him in an online game of `Words with Friends'. However, when Sheldon starts to dominate the game, Hawking is less than pleased.

Die Betreiber eines säumigen Asia-Restaurants zahlen erst, als die Sheriffs mit einer Pfändung drohen. Zudem hilft das Team der Catererin Tanya, an ihr Geld zu kommen, während ein Uhrmacher seine wertvollen Antiquitäten retten will.

Amy gets upset when Sheldon fails to defend her in an argument with Wil Wheaton during the filming of a new episode of `Fun with Flags'. Bernadette pressures Howard to move the rest of his possessions out of his mother's house and into her flat.
The guys notice that Sheldon disappears for 20 minutes right after lunch every day. Filled with curiosity, they attempt to follow him and work out what on earth he's been doing.

Kacie wohnt in einer abgeschiedenen Gegend in Arkansas. Im Online-Chat lernt die 12-Jährige zwei Jungs aus Atlanta und Kalifornien kennen. Eines Tages verschwindet das Mädchen plötzlich. Eine Spur führt zu den beiden Chat-Bekanntschaften.

When non-driver Sheldon finds out that his unused parking space at the university has been reallocated to Howard, he feels undermined. Howard doesn't see the problem in using something that his friend doesn't need and the two fall out.
Sheldon begrudgingly takes care of Amy when she's sick, and she loves the extra attention so much that she pretends to be ill long after she has recovered.

Amanda Howard hat große Pläne: Nach ihrem Abschluss will sie zur Air Force gehen. Doch dann wird sie ungeplant schwanger. Sie sucht im Internet nach Hilfe. Eine Frau behauptet, ihr Babykleidung schenken zu wollen. Die beiden treffen sich.
Sheldon unwillingly reveals some painful memories of Christmas past when Leonard persuades him to join in with a seasonal game of `Dungeons and Dragons'.
Sheldon manages to put his foot in his mouth and ends up being accused of sexual harassment. In typical fashion, he throws his friends under the bus too.

Die alleinerziehende Mutter Jenn Clark steht mitten im Leben und ist erfolgreich in ihrem Beruf. Sie begibt sich auf Partnersuche im Internet und lernt Ray kennen. Doch der gutaussehende Fernsehregisseur ist nicht der, für den er sich ausgibt.

The guys are stranded in the middle of nowhere when Leonard's car is stolen on the way to the Bakersfield Comic-Con. Back home, the women try to figure out why the guys are so fascinated with comic books.
Howard's nerd hobby gets him into money troubles. Sheldon is forced to work with Kripke, who ends up spreading rumours about his sexual relationship with Amy.

Mary Kay Beckman ist Witwe und viel beschäftigte Immobilienmaklerin in Las Vegas. In ihrem Leben bleibt nicht viel Zeit für Verabredungen, deswegen versucht sie es mit Online-Dating. Der 53-jährige Wade Ridley hat es ihr besonders angetan.
Leonard is mad at Sheldon, so he moves in with Penny. Amy notes that she would be the perfect roommate for Sheldon since she knows him so well, and he wouldn't have to break in someone else.
The couples are getting ready for Valentine's Day. Leonard, Penny, Howard and Bernadette are going to dinner and Sheldon and Amy are trying to get the perfect gifts for each other.

Das historische Astor Theatre in Kanada ist bis heute bei Zuschauern sehr beliebt. Doch unter den Gästen soll sich eine geisterhafte Frau befinden: Eine dunkel gekleidete Dame, die mitten im Publikum auftaucht und dann wieder spurlos verschwindet.
After a terrible date with Lucy, the girl he met at Stuart's comic bookshop singles party, Raj vows never to leave his flat or interact with another woman again.
Raj and Lucy have their first date meeting in a library by texting each other. The guys have to promote science careers for women at Howard's old middle school, while the girls go to Disneyland.

In den abgelegenen Badlands untersuchen Johnny und Jordyn das alte Rosedeer Hotel mit seiner düsteren Vergangenheit. Schon kurz nach ihrer Ankunft spüren die Geisterjäger eine unheimliche Präsenz: Geräte reagieren unerklärlich.
Penny and Leonard host a cocktail party. Meanwhile, Howard receives a letter from his father, whom he hasn't heard from since he was 11.
Dr. Sandra Lee treats Taylor, a young woman with elf-like bumps on her ears, and Jose never goes out because of the baseball-sized lump on his head.

Zak und sein Team setzen ihre furchteinflößende Erkundung im historischen Pendleton fort. Ein Hinweis aus der Bevölkerung führt die Geisterjäger in einen unerforschten Teil des geheimnisvollen Tunnelsystems unter der ehemaligen Wildweststadt.
Barbara's back lump became more noticeable after she lost 131 pounds. Meanwhile, Hilda's depression is a result of the multitude of bumps on her eyelids.

Zak und sein Team vermuten, dass böse Kräfte am Werk sind, während sie ein Anwesen untersuchen, das von Gerüchten über geheime Rituale im Keller und einem grausamen Doppelmord nebenan heimgesucht wird. Die Gruppe betritt dunkles Terrain.
Dr. Sandra Lee treats Heather, who has a huge growth on her leg and fears removing it could leave a keloid scar. Paul has a giant hump on his back.
Zwei Schwestern kauften 2019 das Smugglers Inn. Bald hörten sie Geschichten über Geister in der Kneipe.

Terry's nose growth has prevented him from meeting his grandkids. Remi has alligator-like skin and is not used to taking care of herself. Austin has an embarrassing birthmark right next to his eyelid. Mary Jo has a throbbing bump on her neck.
Brick may be held back from going to the third grade because of Mrs Nethercott, the school librarian. Meanwhile, Axl emerges as academically gifted after an aptitude test.
Brick's new teacher accuses Frankie of being overprotective when she comes up with a plan to stay on top of her kids' schedules.

Frankie and Mike have a dilemma: one of them must proudly walk Axl onto the football field at Homecoming, while the other waits for Sue to stagger over the finish line at her first cross-country meet. Who pulls the short straw?
Roger has enormous growths on his nose that drip pus, attract flies and are so large that he can barely breathe. Sandra and Jessie are sisters who bonded over their many undiagnosed face bumps.
pr.sub: My Giant Nose Is Killing Me

In der Verkaufssendung werden verschiedene Produkte von unterschiedlichen Herstellern präsentiert.

Als Rugo eine Zeitkapsel entdeckt, die Ayati vor 100 Jahren mit ihrer Freundin erstellt hat, beschließen die vier kleinen Dinos, ebenfalls eine zu gestalten. Die Zeitkapsel wird zu einer spannenden Reise durch die Geschichte.

Marshall wünscht sich, so wie Giganto zu sein. Woraufhin die vier Dinosaurier ihn in einen gruseligen Dinosaurier verwandeln. Doch jetzt fliehen alle bei seinem Erscheinen und Marshall erkennt, dass es viel besser ist, einfach er selbst zu sein.

Der Waldkater ist auf das Äußerste bestürzt. In der Weihnachtszeit muss er beobachten, wie seine Lieblingstanne aus dem Wald geschleppt wird. Er hat keine Wahl und wendet sich an Oggy Oggy um Hilfe, damit der sie wieder zurückbringt.

Weihnachten, das Fest der Liebe und guten Gaben, kann jetzt kommen. Oggy Oggy hat seinen Baum zum Fest sehr dekorativ geschmückt und wartet nun gespannt auf seine Geschenke, möglichst viele davon, denn er hat es sich verdient - findet er.

Oggy Oggy, Sporty und Mallow haben ein schweres Problem zu klären. Sie haben sich die Frage gestellt, wer eigentlich den Weihnachtskater beschenkt. Er soll nicht leer ausgehen, meinen sie und deshalb soll er auch ein Geschenk bekommen.

Leonard freut sich sehr über seine neue Arbeit. Er arbeitet von nun an im Supermarkt. Auch seine Freunde sind voller Euphorie, denn sie werden an der Fleischtheke aushelfen. Das Trio muss ermitteln, als die Kunden ausbleiben.

Das Trio macht Bekanntschaft mit einem bekannten und talentierten Künstler namens Shona. Sie wollen ihn unterstützen und nun selbst Kunst erschaffen. Dabei bekommen die Freunde eine einmalige Chance. Ihre Kunst wird der Königin vorgestellt.

Die Freunde werden zu Polizisten. Sie erleben einige Abenteuer, als sie im Dienst sind. Sie ermitteln gegen einen Dieb, der die Lebensmittel der Bewohner klaut. Herr Krok ist verdächtig für die Freunde. Sie untersuchen sein Alibi.
Peppa und ihre Familie fliegen in den Urlaub.
Peppa und ihre Familie kommen in Italien an. Sie bemerken, dass dort alle eine andere Sprache sprechen und Papa Wutz findet es schwierig, auf der anderen Seite der Straße zu fahren.
Heute ist der erste Tag in der Ferienvilla und Familie Wutz erkundet das Dorf.
Peppa hat ihren ersten Urlaub sehr genossen, aber nun ist es Zeit, wieder nach Hause zu fahren. Sie freut sich sehr, Luzie Locke und Goldie endlich wieder zu sehen.

Die Elfen ärgern sich über den Balbo, der mit seiner Ungeschicklichkeit wieder einmal für Chaos in der Spielzeugfabrik gesorgt hat. Sie setzen ihn vor die Tür. Traurig beschließt Balbo, den Nordpol zu verlassen. Er verpackt sich selbst als Präsent und lässt sich per Post zu dem kleinen Pablo schicken, der sich einen Stoffbären gewünscht hat.

pr.t: Paw Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten
pr.d: Bürgermeister Gutherz freut sich schon auf die große Hühner-Schau in der Abenteuerbucht. Sie ist überzeugt, dass ihre Henrietta gewinnen wird. Doch dann kommt es zur großen Katastrophe und die Paw Patrol muss alles wieder in Ordnung bringen.

pr.t: Paw Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten
pr.d: Als Bettina auf einer Bergwanderung in einem Schneesturm stecken bleibt, ist es an der PAW Patrol, sie sicher herunterzuholen.

Als die kleine Alva versehentlich eine Scheibe in der Tischlerei zerbricht, beschuldigt Meister Eder fälschlicherweise Pumuckl. Der Kobold ist zutiefst empört über diese Ungerechtigkeit und lässt das nicht auf sich sitzen.

pr.t: Paw Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten
pr.d: Als Ryder und seine Fellfreunde der Paw Patrol schon den ganzen Tag voller Vorfreude auf ihr neues Lieblingsspiel "Fellfreund-Boogie" warten, will ihr Paket einfach nicht ankommen. Es sind verbogene Zuggleise, die gewaltige Probleme verursachen.

pr.t: Paw Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten
pr.d: Der Leuchtturm ist kaputt. Ein Kreuzfahrtschiff steuert im Nebel auf die Robbeninsel zu. Ryder und seine Freunde müssen den Leuchtturm reparieren, bevor das Schiff mit seinen Passagieren auf Grund läuft.

pr.t: Paw Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten
pr.d: Ein Schwarm Wildgänse rastet in der Zentrale der Paw Patrol. Ein Küken verschwindet.

pr.t: Paw Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten
pr.d: Bürgermeisterin Goodway möchte an der Heißluftballon-Wettfahrt der Bürgermeister teilnehmen. Bevor sie allerdings mit dem Gefährt aufsteigen darf, muss der lädierte Ballon von Ryder und seinen Freunden auf Vordermann gebracht werden.

pr.t: Paw Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten
pr.d: Alex will das Snowboarding erlernen und meldet sich sofort zum Unterricht an. Doch Snowboardfahren ist schwieriger als es aussieht. Unerwartet stecken er und sein Lehrer auf einem Felsvorsprung fest. Das ist ein Fall für die Paw Patrol.

pr.t: Paw Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten
pr.d: Der Snowboardunterricht ist anders gelaufen, als geplant und jetzt sitzen Jake und Alex fest. Jake, der Snowboardlehrer, ruft schließlich Ryder und die Paw Patrol zu Hilfe, die sich sofort auf den Weg machen, um die beiden zu retten.

pr.t: Paw Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten
pr.d: Die Freunde suchen ein Elefantenbaby vom Zirkus, das aus seinem Transportwaggon ausgebrochen ist.

pr.t: Paw Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten
pr.d: Das Huhn der Bürgermeisterin verschwindet während eines Interviews. Die Freunde suchen nach ihm.

Kinshi ist verzweifelt, denn sie möchte unbedingt größer werden. Jordi möchte sie dabei unterstützen, indem er aus Pfingstrosenblüten einen Wachstumstrank mixt. Da er sich mit der Dosierung nicht auskennt, geht sein Plan nicht auf.

Ein falscher Weihnachtsmann hat die Weihnachtspost umgeleitet. Die Elfen suchen nach dem Betrüger.

Grantelbart möchte Weihnachten verhindern und entwickelt ein magisches Pulver, mit dem er die Geschenke zum Leben erwecken kann. Kurz darauf veranstalten diese sehr viel Chaos und das Weihnachtsfest ist somit nicht mehr sicher.

Der faszinierende Football-Sport wird anschaulich, verständlich und kindgerecht erklärt.

Idris' Leben gerät aus den Fugen, als seine Familie Kat, eine Katzen-Wereling, bei sich aufnimmt. Werelings sind Menschen mit der Fähigkeit, sich in menschlich-tierische Mischwesen zu verwandeln. Eine Fähigkeit, die sie als Jugendliche entdecken.

Grenache treibt wieder ihr Unwesen in Paloma und Kat verhält sich plötzlich merkwürdig. Sie wälzt sich auf dem Boden herum, schnurrt ständig und verwandelt sich unkontrolliert in ihre Katzenform! Da nicht die ganze Welt von ihrer Katzen-Seite erfahren soll, muss sie sehr vorsichtig sein. Was hat ihr ungewöhnliches Verhalten nur ausgelöst? Dimitri und Idris begeben sich auf Spurensuche.

Der junge Delfin Jim wird mit einer besonderen Aufgabe betraut: Er wird Kapitän des ersten U-Boots auf Rädern. Doch allerlei Verwicklungen und kuriose Zeitgenossen machen es ihm immer wieder äußerst schwierig, seine Aufgabe zu erfüllen.

pr.d: Sponge Bob und seine Freunde fahren für ein Wiedersehens­treffen nach Kamp Koral. Plötzlich werden sie von einer mysteriösen Gestalt verfolgt, die sich in den Schatten versteckt hält. Die Camper werden einer nach dem anderen entführt.

Odette, das einfache Dorfmädchen, wird vom bösen Zauberer Rothbart in einen Schwan verwandelt. Nur in der Nacht nimmt sie wieder ihre menschliche Gestalt an. Kann Odette dem Zauberer das Handwerk legen?
Blubberbernd und die Drecksackblase tun sich zusammen, um Bikini Bottom zu nerven.
Als Plankton eine magische Bohne findet, wird er in ein Land voller Riesen entführt.
Mats zeigt Malik seine neue Uhr und ist sehr stolz dabei. Doch dann fällt sie in den Gully.

Malika und Mats sind gerade auf dem Weg zur Schule, als ihnen eine Baustelle den Weg versperrt. Sie müssen sich einen anderen Weg suchen. Am besten eine Abkürzung. Dabei stoßen sie auf die Ruinen eines uralten römischen Amphitheaters.
Bei Mats steht auf dem Plan, dass er sich übers Wochenende um die Pflanze der Klasse kümmern soll.

The night might be a time humans avoid, but for most mammals it has always been a world of opportunity. Mammals first emerged during the time of the dinosaurs. To avoid competition with these mighty rivals, they stayed small and only active at night.

For millions of years, mammals have evolved to master every environment on Earth, but the planet is changing rapidly, all thanks to one mammal in particular: humans. As mankind reshapes the world, mammals must change with it if they are to survive.

A look at some of the most intimate and surprising behaviours of marine mammals. Raising the bar of human understanding of how whales and dolphins make their lives at sea, as well as meeting terrestrial mammals that dip their toes into the water.

Having honed their survival strategies over millennia, mammals have evolved to be masters of the cold. From icy seas to snow-capped mountains, a look at the unique mammals that call these frozen worlds home.

The crews attend a man who has fallen off his bike and a 4-year-old struggling with a painful case of tonsillitis. Plus, a 35-year-old man with chest pains proves very hard to find.

DS Phil Hunter inadvertently asks Kate to marry him, Gina Gold returns to work but relies on June Ackland to oversee the relief, and DC Gary Best is shot in the back while investigating a stolen goods scam.

pr.sub: A Small Price to Pay: Part Two

Elsewhere, Rochelle and Dan are caught during a steamy liaison in her office. Plus, Tony dumps Amber at a works party, and Jack questions Neil about his relationship with Susie Sim.
pr.sub: A Small Price to Pay: Part Three

pr.d: A teacher who has been assaulted by one of her pupils reluctantly agrees to press charges. Plus, DC Ramani De Costa is devastated to discover DC Terry Perkins' affair with his sister-in-law. Meanwhile, Adam Okaro is on leave and DCI Jack Meadows steps in as acting superintendent. Then elsewhere, Sheelagh fears that her relationship with Gabriel may be coming to an end.

Jack Meadows arrests his son for possession of cocaine and asks Neil Manson and Terry Perkins to interview him. Plus, Benjamin's prints match those from an assault case, and Jack realises that his son is in deep trouble. Meanwhile, Ramani De Costa and Samantha Nixon investigate the disappearance of a young nurse, and Peter Baxter turns up at Sun Hill.
A dangerous driver in a pick-up truck causes carnage when his vehicle rolls over and the HART team are called to free him and his passenger from the wreckage.
A hitman with links to a drugs gang guns down two men in a supermarket car park. Later, a teenage dare leads to a massive rescue operation after a boy vanishes in the water.
A truck drives through the barrier of a busy motorway and hits a BMW head-on. The team join a delicate rescue operation to persuade a suicidal man down from a bridge.
Reality series following the work of Yorkshire Ambulance Service's Hazardous Area Response Team.
The team are called to a major fire in a chemicals factory, and paramedics join forces with the firefighters desperately searching for teenagers reported missing in a swollen river.
Pete tries to win over a wary Greyhound, supports a St Bernard with complex health needs and helps rehome a returned Belgian Malinois.
Seven-year-old Nancy has an operation to straighten her squint and ex-Army man Mervyn, who served in Afghanistan and Iraq, has a procedure to get rid of constant back pain.
Laura makes a life-changing decision after suffering from post-natal depression and Anne needs an operation to remove a painful bony lump from her foot.

Susan's scheme to lure Ben to a country house for a Christmas for two without the children and then `surprise' him with the family on Christmas Day is doomed to result in chaos, but that will not stop her from trying.

pr.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
pr.d: The boys head to Leicestershire for a furniture-filled shed belonging to Matthew, a French pieces enthusiast. Simon chooses a huge canoe, while Henry picks a gymnasium vaulting horse.

Michael Portillo begins with a tour of the Home Counties and beyond, starting in the city of dreaming spires, Oxford, where in 1921 women were awarded degrees for the first time. At Somerville College, Michael finds out about a pioneering crystallographer, Dorothy Hodgkin, the only British woman to win a Nobel Prize for chemistry.

Greater Manchester's Metrolink tram delivers Michael to the former cotton town of Oldham on the edge of the Peak District. In the stalls of the Oldham Coliseum, the town's Victorian repertory theatre, Michael hears about the lifting of censorship.
Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

Michael Portillo heads for leafy Hatch End, where he investigates an illustrator whose work was so popular in the 1920s and 30s that his name entered the English dictionary. William Heath Robinson's great-nephew talks Michael through some of the mad contraptions the artist used to satirise technology.

From Wakefield, West Yorkshire, Michael visits the National Coal Mining Museum for England at Caphouse Colliery. He pauses to admire the tall spire of Wakefield Cathedral and its resident peregrine falcons before heading to the banks of the Calder.

Michael Portillo continues his 1,000-mile journey from the northern state of Minnesota to the home of the blues in Memphis, Tennessee. At the ornate Palmer House Hotel, Michael recreates the original chocolate Brownie.

Beginning with a look at the early use of wind and water power, Fred traces the development of the steam engine and visits a man who has built a windmill in his own back garden. He then sets off in search of early beam engines that are still functioning today.
Travelling from the Scottish countryside of New Lanark to Burnley, Fred talks to ex weavers about life in the mills and meets a group of volunteers who have spent 30 years saving mill engines.

Fred shifts his attention to the development of the iron and steel industries, starting with Ironbridge Gorge in Shropshire. He comes across a rolling mill which he remembers once operating in Bolton, tries his hand at chain making, and then it's eyes-on-stalks time as Fred drives the biggest steam rolling mill engine he has ever seen.

Starting in Cornwall and travelling all the way to Scotland, Fred turns his eye to the practice of mining. On his travels, he finds out exactly how tin, slate, lead and coal were all extracted from the ground.
In Port Isaac, on the north coast of Cornwall, the crew race to the rescue of a female casualty with a spinal injury. With the light fading, she's in a precarious position on a rock face.
A busy loco maintenance team expects the unexpected, installing a challenging water tank on a vintage loco. An electronics team fights e-waste.
pr.sub: Loco Maintenance Team Expect The Unexpected

pr.d: The first port of call on Martin's journey is Hawaii. His exploration looks beyond Hawaii's image as a tourist paradise, crammed with sun-kissed beaches and world-class surfing, and into the havoc wreaked by advancing lava fields and smoking craters.

Actor Martin Clunes has been a keen surface diver for over ten years and he has a deep fascination for manta rays. Boasting a wingspan of 25 feet, manta rays are one of the most mysterious and gentle giants of the ocean.

On the last leg of his 300-mile journey across the north and the Midlands, Robbie Cumming faces issues with ice on the Grand Union Canal. He takes on Foxton's famous lock flight in Leicestershire and completes his journey in the picturesque village Braunston, Northamptonshire, regarded as the spiritual home for narrowboaters.
Life on England's waterways with Robbie Cumming. A low canal tunnel in Staffordshire proves a problem, and Robbie helps out a stranded boater.
The reality of life afloat with Robbie Cumming. A fallen tree and a leaking lock pound hamper Robbie's journey across the Pennines.
The real side of boat life with Robbie Cumming. Robbie runs aground on the Rochdale Canal - will he make it to Manchester?

Comedian Bill Bailey heads to the jungles of Indonesia in the footsteps of his hero, Victorian naturalist Alfred Russel Wallace, to understand how he came up with the theory of evolution independently of Darwin. In the first of this two part series, Bill retraces Wallace's explorations from the jungles of Borneo to the exotic islands of Indonesia, encountering orangutans, flying frogs and extraordinary bugs.

Water plants create some of the most beautiful, bizarre and important habitats on earth. To hold on in torrents, plants use a kind of superglue. Some are armed with vicious weapons to fight titanic battles for space. Others form perfect spheres and escape from animal enemies by rolling. Where nutrients are washed away, plants turn into hunters of animals, laying traps and even counting to ensure their success.

Between the tropics and the frozen poles lies a region dominated by relentless change in the form of the four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter. Each one presents plants with huge challenges, from ice and snow to raging fires, from intense competition to surprising enemies. This is a world of astonishing variety and vibrant colour. To survive here plants must use strategy, deception and remarkable feats of engineering. Most importantly, they must get their timing right.
The team opt for a 1965 Ford Cortina Estate, supposedly owned by a South African Chief of Police, and take on one of Dave's guilty pleasures: a 1980s Austin Morris Max.
It's a battle of little and large as the team get creative with a 1996 Fiat 126 and then run their own consumer test on a 2004 Bentley Continental GT.

pr.t: Inside Bentley: A Great British Motor Car
pr.d: Bentley Motors have been building bespoke cars for the rich and famous for almost a century, and for the first time in their long history, the doors of its historic home in northwest England have been opened to the cameras.

pr.t: Inside Bentley: A Great British Motorcar
pr.d: Documentary going behind the scenes at the car company's plant as work gets underway on a range of 4x4s, from the factory floor to the world's most exclusive car showroom.

Jim talks up his involvement in a public-private partnership project, not knowing the financial irregularities that could lead to land him in hot water. The only way out seems to give a part-time government appointment that he is trying to abolish.
The Minister sees an opportunity to further his career when a newly built and fully staffed hospital seems to have no patients.
Jim Hacker plans to block honours for civil servants until cost-cutting measures are introduced in their departments. Naturally, Sir Humphrey plans his own retaliation.
Dave's son Jack is heading out to Cheshire to collect two cars with a 35-year age difference. And luckily for Mathewson's, Lucy knows exactly what has been brought in for auction.

Comedian Bill Bailey heads to the jungles of Indonesia in the footsteps of his hero, Victorian naturalist Alfred Russel Wallace, to understand how he came up with the theory of evolution independently of Darwin. In the first of this two part series, Bill retraces Wallace's explorations from the jungles of Borneo to the exotic islands of Indonesia, encountering orangutans, flying frogs and extraordinary bugs.

Water plants create some of the most beautiful, bizarre and important habitats on earth. To hold on in torrents, plants use a kind of superglue. Some are armed with vicious weapons to fight titanic battles for space. Others form perfect spheres and escape from animal enemies by rolling. Where nutrients are washed away, plants turn into hunters of animals, laying traps and even counting to ensure their success.

Between the tropics and the frozen poles lies a region dominated by relentless change in the form of the four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter. Each one presents plants with huge challenges, from ice and snow to raging fires, from intense competition to surprising enemies. This is a world of astonishing variety and vibrant colour. To survive here plants must use strategy, deception and remarkable feats of engineering. Most importantly, they must get their timing right.

Presenters Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer mix a cookery show with a chat show, and the result is `Sunday Brunch.'
